title: Vice President (m/f/d) Equity Rebalancing
description: Company Description Solactive AG is a FinTech company operating globally and growing at a fast pace, headquartered in Frankfurt. Since 2007, we develop tailor-made and multi-asset class index solutions for ETFs and other index-linked investment products for the leading global investment banks and asset managers as our clients. Flexibility, efficiency and providing the highest quality are at the heart and soul of our business philosophy. We are now hiring! Job Overview Are you passionate about capital markets, index investing, and client-facing investment solutions? Do you thrive at the intersection of investment strategy, portfolio construction, and operational excellence in a fast-paced, international environment? We are seeking a highly experienced and client-focused capital markets professional to take ownership of a portfolio of quantitative equity indices while serving as a trusted partner to a global client base. The successful candidate will combine a strong understanding of financial markets and quantitative investment strategies with excellent communication and relationship-management skills, translating complex concepts into clear, actionable insights for clients and stakeholders across global markets. Your Tasks Manage and oversee a diverse portfolio of quantitative equity indices, ensuring the accurate and timely execution of all rebalancing activities while maintaining a strong understanding of the underlying investment strategies and client objectives. Serve as a senior point of contact for an international client base, including leading investment banks, asset managers, hedge funds, and trading desks, acting as a trusted advisor on index methodologies, rebalancing outcomes, and quantitative investment strategies. Lead and coordinate the resolution of client inquiries, escalations, and complex index-related issues, delivering clear, actionable guidance and ensuring a high standard of client service. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency, scalability, and service quality across index management and client support processes. Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including Data, Engineering, and Product, to ensure seamless end-to-end delivery and the successful implementation of client requirements. Your Profile Academic degree in Finance, Financial Engineering, Financial Mathematics, or Engineering. At least 6 years of experience in equity markets execution, portfolio management, index management, or in a similar process-driven financial environment. Strong understanding of equity markets, ETFs, index construction, or systematic investment strategies. Excellent communication skills with the ability to clearly explain complex topics to both technical and non-technical audiences. Strong sense of ownership, able to operate independently and manage operational responsibility across multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Strong organizational skills and ability to handle time-sensitive operational workflows. Team-oriented with a collaborative mindset and intercultural competence. Python skills are an asset. Fluency in English. Our Offer Global Team: Join our motivated international team at Solactive. FinTech Excellence: Experience innovation and excellence in FinTech. Modern Culture: Thrive in a flat-hierarchy, startup-like environment. Vacation & Work-Life Balance: Enjoy 30 annual vacation days plus extra time off for Christmas Eve and New Year. Competitive Compensation & Benefits: Receive a market-competitive salary, job ticket, gym membership, and access to Corporate Benefits. Employer Pension Contribution: Benefit from the occupational pension scheme (bAV). Professional Development & Certifications: Grow personally and professionally, with support for certifications and training opportunities. Community & Networking: Participate in networking and team engagement events. Flexibility: Embrace a hybrid work model in a diverse and dynamic environment. title: Senior Internal Controls Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">📍Dublin | 💶 €91,000 - €111,500 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + benefits | <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U62l09nB0M4">Hear from the team</a> ✨</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>⭐ Our Finance team</strong></span></p> <p>We are looking for a Senior Internal Controls Manager to join the Finance team at Monzo Bank Europe DAC based in Dublin.</p> <p>You will help Finance build and maintain a strong risk and control environment as we develop and grow our business across European markets. You will test key Finance controls, review evidence, support regulatory reporting assurance, track remediation actions and help improve the way Finance manages risk.</p> <p>Working across Financial Control, Regulatory Reporting, Treasury, FP&A, Tax, Risk & Compliance and Internal Audit, you will bring your accounting expertise, strong attention to detail and a practical approach to controls. You will be comfortable challenging processes, writing clear findings and helping teams improve.</p> <p>This is a great role for someone from audit, financial control or risk assurance who wants to help build a high-quality and robust Finance control environment in a growing digital bank.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Maintaining a robust and well-documented risk and control environment by improving documentation, evidence standards and control processes for the Finance team, and helping to ensure Finance-owned risks are aligned with MBEU’s risk appetite and the wider Enterprise Risk Management Framework.</li> <li>Designing, maintaining and enhancing Finance risk and control matrices for key processes.</li> <li>Performing regular control testing and review of evidence across Finance processes, including financial reporting, month-end close, balance sheet reconciliations, regulatory reporting, tax, treasury and capital/liquidity-related processes.</li> <li>Testing Finance controls and assessing design and operating effectiveness. Identifying control gaps, recommending enhancements, and embedding change by tracking remediation actions and progress.</li> <li>Leading and supporting Finance risk and control self-assessments, including evidence gathering, challenge and documentation.</li> <li>Preparing concise updates for Finance leadership on control testing results, open issues, remediation progress and emerging risks. Supporting risk assurance reporting to MBEU governance forums.</li> <li>Working with second-line Risk & Compliance teams on oversight reviews, assurance planning and risk reporting.</li> <li>Supporting Internal Audit and external audit requests relating to Finance controls.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>Hold a recognised accounting qualification, or be close to qualification, such as ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CPA Ireland or equivalent.</li> <li>Have detailed experience in audit, financial control, risk assurance, internal controls or regulatory reporting.</li> <li>Have experience in Banking, fintech or financial services experience.</li> <li>Can demonstrate a strong understanding of accounting processes, balance sheet controls, reconciliations and financial reporting risks.</li> <li>Have experience testing or reviewing controls, including assessing design and operating effectiveness.</li> <li>Can demonstrate strong attention to detail and ability to challenge evidence, assumptions and process weaknesses.</li> <li>Have experience in documenting robust processes, risks, controls, issues and remediation plans clearly.</li> <li>Have good interpersonal and influencing skills, ability to engage across various internal functions to develop, get buy-in and deliver outcomes across teams</li> <li>Have the ability to confidently present data in a meaningful and effective way; understanding the needs of the end users and tailoring presentations to their requirements</li> <li>Have experience building strong trusted relationships with stakeholders at all levels</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💶 A salary range of €91,000 - €111,500 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance</p> <p>📍This role will have a hybrid working model, based in our Dublin office 2 - 3 days a week. You will also travel to Monzo’s head office in London from time to time</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team</p> <p>🏝 Annual Leave - 34 days including public holidays (24 holiday days + 10 public holidays)</p> <p>📚€1,200 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>🏥 Private healthcare scheme</p> <p>💰Pension scheme: the minimum contribution is 4% and Monzo matches any additional contributions that you make up to a maximum of 6%</p> <p>💛 Wellbeing benefits: financial education, women’s and men’s health support, mental health benefits, including coaching and counselling</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ol> <li>An introductory video call with a member of the Monzo Recruitment team</li> <li>An initial video call with the hiring manager</li> <li>A series of role specific, behavioural & leadership principles interviews</li> </ol> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We'll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don't miss out.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Software Engineer Intern (2027) - Austin, TX
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations</strong></p> <ul> <li>Austin, US</li> </ul> <p><strong>Available Terms</strong></p> <ul> <li>Winter/Spring (January - May 2027) </li> <li>Summer (May - September 2027)</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>Anytime we push code, it automatically affects the millions of Internet properties (powering websites, remote teams, APIs, mobile apps, etc.) running on our global network. Cloudflare's network is one of the largest in the world and spans over 330 cities in more than 125 countries. What's more, Cloudflare operates within 50 milliseconds of 95% of the Internet-connected population globally (for context, the blink of an eye is 300-400 milliseconds!). We are passionate about making the Internet more secure, reliable, and faster for everyone.</p> <p>Cloudflare’s Engineering teams build and run the software that handles the massive amount of traffic that flows through our network. We also have teams that build the UI and control plane for our software, using modern patterns and libraries in a microservices-based architecture. Technologies include: Typescript/Javascript, Go, Rust, C/C++ and Python.</p> <p>The ideal intern is passionate about making the Internet a better place. You will work alongside experienced engineers. You will push code this internship that touches hundreds of millions of web surfers. We like to get things done, so we are looking for interns who are curious, proactive, and able to complete projects. This is a great opportunity for engineers who want to learn to develop at Internet scale.</p> <p>You can check out our <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/tag/internship-experience/">internship blogs</a> to learn more about our program and hear directly from our past interns.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ship and deliver projects over 12-14 weeks with autonomy and support.</li> <li>Work cross-functionally with various teams.</li> <li>Work closely with a mentor to guide you through the internship and help with career goals.</li> <li>Build your network across the company through our various in and out of office socials, networking programs, Employee Resource Group (ERG) programs, and Activity Groups.</li> <li>Present your project to the entire company at the end of the internship.</li> <li>Connect and learn from our executives and leadership team including our co-founders.</li> <li>Learn and develop skills through our professional development workshops.</li> <li>Write for our <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/">Cloudflare blog</a> and be featured on <a href="http://cloudflare.tv/">Cloudflare.tv</a> sessions. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Currently pursuing a degree or program in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics or relevant field to the role.</li> <li>Demonstrated critical thinking skills and drive to learn and adapt new technologies.</li> <li>Curiosity, empathy and ability to get things done.</li> <li>Ability to commit to a full-time (40 hours/week Monday - Friday) for a minimum 12 week internship.</li> <li>In office 3-5 days a week in Austin, TX.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points</strong></p> <p>Demonstrated passion for software development, such as personal projects, open-source contributions, or experience with our developer platform using <a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/students/">Cloudflare for Students.</a></p> <p><strong>Please note</strong></p> <ul> <li>We will be hiring interns on a rolling basis until all roles are filled.</li> <li>We are not considering remote or part-time for either terms. This is a full-time (40hr/week internship) with in-person expectations; standard business hours are typically 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM. You should not be enrolled in classes, which would conflict with full-time commitment.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

needs someone in the room immediately.</li> <li>Assess when Platform Staff should hand work off to a permanent team once it's stable.</li> <li>Set the technical bar across all three functions by personally reviewing distributed systems designs, friction-elimination fixes, and crisis management plans with equal depth.</li> <li>Build the operating rhythm and metrics that keep all three functions running predictably, so none of them relies on any one person working unsustainable hours.</li> <li>Represent all three functions to peer engineering stakeholders, and step in front of customers directly when Platform Staff is engaged mid-crisis.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Working knowledge of GitLab's development workflows and platform capabilities so you can assess productivity friction, operational trade-offs, and team needs in context.</li> <li>Hands-on experience designing and shipping distributed systems personally, not only through teams you've managed.</li> <li>A track record running highly effective engineering operations, including production reliability and incident management, at meaningful scale.</li> <li>A track record driving measurable engineering productivity improvements across more than one team or organization.</li> <li>Experience with AI-assisted development tools, and sound judgment about when they help a small team do work that would otherwise require a larger team.</li> <li>People management experience across multiple managers or functions at once.</li> <li>Ability to context-switch effectively across genuinely different problem types, including infrastructure operations, developer productivity, and ad hoc crisis response, sometimes in the same week.</li> <li>A track record making staffing decisions that keep a high-leverage team intentionally small, and building alignment around those decisions rather than growing the team by default.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>We work across three connected platform and productivity functions. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p class="p1"><strong>An overview of this role</strong></p> <p class="p3">As a Support Engineer at GitLab, you’ll sit at the intersection of Support and Engineering, helping customers solve complex, real-world challenges running GitLab in diverse and demanding environments. You’ll be embedded in the Engineering department, working directly with customers as they hit edge cases, digging into Linux systems, logs, and our Ruby on Rails codebase to troubleshoot performance issues, reproduce bugs, and contribute merge requests that fix problems at the source. You’ll also improve our documentation, refine support processes in our issue tracker, and collaborate closely with Product, Development, Infrastructure, Customer Success, and Sales so that customer feedback directly shapes our roadmap. In your first year, you’ll build deep expertise across a range of GitLab implementations, strengthen our ability to keep customers productive on both self-managed and GitLab.com (SaaS), and help create tools and content that make support more efficient and effective for the entire team.</p> <p class="p3">Some examples of our projects:</p> <ul class="ul1"> <li class="li3"><span class="s1"><a href="https://gitlab.com/gitlab-com/support/toolbox/gitlab-detective">A tool to automatically check a GitLab Omnibus install for known issues</a></span></li> <li class="li3"><span class="s1"><a href="https://gitlab.com/gitlab-com/support/toolbox/gitlabsos">A solution to capture the state of a customer’s server for easier troubleshooting</a></span></li> <li class="li3"><span class="s1"><a href="https://gitlab.com/gitlab-com/support/toolbox/sosparser">A tool which turns log files into interactive tables to easily sort and filter columns</a></span></li> <li class="li3"><span class="s1"><a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/ci/chatops/">A functionality to ChatOps to make it easier to identify user accounts on </a><a href="http://GitLab.com">GitLab.com</a></span></li> </ul> <p class="p1"><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul class="ul1"> <li class="li3">Support a mix of Self-managed and GitLab.com (SaaS) customers, resolving complex issues through Zendesk tickets, merge requests, email, and video calls.</li> <li class="li3">Collaborate with Product, Development, Infrastructure, Customer Success, and Sales teams to shape product goals, roadmap, and priorities while driving fixes and new features.</li> <li class="li3">Investigate and troubleshoot issues using Linux systems administration tools, logs, and the GitLab codebase, creating merge requests when needed to resolve customer problems.</li> <li class="li3">Create and update clear, reusable documentation and support content based on real customer interactions and edge cases.</li> <li class="li3">Partner with Support team members through pairing sessions and cross-team collaborations (such as Support Stable Counterparts) to solve challenging cases and share knowledge.</li> <li class="li3">Participate in regular weekday and weekend on-call rotations (daytime only), providing emergency support for Self-managed and SaaS customers and coordinating incident communications with the SaaS Production team.</li> <li class="li3">Contribute to improving support processes, tools, and automation within our issue tracker to make troubleshooting and case handling more efficient.</li> <li class="li3">Participate in hiring by reviewing applications and assessments and joining interviews to help grow the Support team.</li> </ul> <p class="p1"><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></p> <ul class="ul1"> <li class="li3">Experience managing customer-facing technical cases from first contact through triage, reproduction, bug reporting, and resolution.</li> <li class="li3">Strong Linux systems administration knowledge comparable to LFCE or RHCE certification.</li> <li class="li3">Ability to use scripting languages such as Ruby or Bash and work with MVC frameworks such as Ruby on Rails.</li> <li class="li3">Hands-on experience with Git and CI/CD in production or customer environments.</li> <li class="li3">Skill in writing clear, accurate support content and documentation based on real customer scenarios.</li> <li class="li3">Ability to explain complex technical topics to people with varying levels of technical expertise.</li> <li class="li3">Familiarity with DevOps practices and technologies such as Kubernetes and Serverless, and how different GitLab implementations operate and impact customers.</li> <li class="li3">Openness to learning, collaborating across teams, and applying transferable skills from related technical support or engineering roles.</li> </ul> <p class="p4"> </p> <p class="p1"><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p class="p3">We are a globally distributed group of Support Engineers across AMER, EMEA, and APAC who help GitLab customers keep their Self-managed and GitLab.com environments running smoothly. data, and event anomalies, and route alerts to the designated feature teams.</li> <li value="3">Develop reconciliation and data integrity checks across usage and billing pipelines.</li> <li value="4">Define and track service reliability targets (SLOs) and service level indicators (SLIs) to measure reliability, write runbooks, and take part in incident handling.</li> <li value="5">Explore artificial intelligence and machine learning techniques to predict system anomalies and accelerate resolution.</li> <li value="6">Review merge requests and offer feedback to other Monetization engineers.</li> <li value="7">Collaborate with Product, Finance, Support, and other partners to turn operational needs into reliable tooling.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Professional experience with Ruby on Rails.</li> <li value="2">A background in site reliability or observability engineering, including monitoring, alerting, SLOs, SLIs, runbooks, incident data stores for reporting and insights, especially ClickHouse, and the change data capture and event streaming pipelines that feed them, such as NATS JetStream.</li> <li value="5">Experience with billing, financial, or other business-critical systems.</li> <li value="6">Experience owning a project from concept to production, including proposal, discussion, execution, and monitoring.</li> <li value="7">Clear, concise communication about complex technical, architectural, and organizational problems in English, with the ability to propose thorough, iterative solutions in a remote and largely asynchronous work environment.</li> <li value="8">Additional relevant experience includes working knowledge of Python for anomaly detection and data work, and experience with Zuora or Salesforce.</li> Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p>As a Staff Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) at GitLab, you’ll help keep all user-facing services and production systems reliable, scalable, and efficient. Our SREs combine a pragmatic operations mindset with strong software engineering practices to drive automation, reduce toil, and improve resilience across our platform.</p> <p>In the Environment Automation specialization, your focus is on operating and automating hundreds of GitLab environments—from initial provisioning to day-to-day maintenance tasks. </p> <p>Unlike other SRE roles, this position centers on automating the lifecycle of many tenant environments, ensuring they remain secure, consistent, and reliable at scale.</p> <p>Some examples of the projects you could work on:</p> <ul> <li>Designing infrastructure automation that provisions and operates GitLab environments using Terraform, Ansible, and Kubernetes</li> <li>Creating and maintaining deployment packages for GitLab, such as Helm Charts and omnibus-gitlab</li> <li>Building and operating Dedicated GitLab instances integrated with cloud-native services (e.g., GCP, AWS)</li> <li>Developing tools to orchestrate infrastructure-as-code workflows across multiple tenants</li> <li>Deploying and managing microservices on Kubernetes clusters at scale</li> <li>Enhancing GitLab’s observability stack (e.g., Prometheus, ELK) to support proactive monitoring and incident response</li> <li>Integrating with and operating infrastructure in cloud provider ecosystems (e.g., IAM, networking, storage)</li> <li>Championing and implementing cloud security best practices across automated infrastructure</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Build & Scale Multi-Tenant Infrastructure:</strong> Design and implement automation that provisions and manages hundreds of isolated GitLab environments using Terraform, Ansible, and Kubernetes. Manage complex state strategies and workspace configurations to support scale and maintainability.</li> <li><strong>Debug & Resolve Production Issues: </strong>Troubleshoot issues across Kubernetes clusters, cloud services, and GitLab apps—identifying root causes of failed deployments, crash loops, and scheduling conflicts to ensure service continuity.</li> <li><strong>Automate Operations at Scale: </strong>Replace manual workflows with infrastructure-as-code solutions, including automated version upgrades, configuration rollouts, and provisioning pipelines that operate reliably across all tenants.</li> <li><strong>Monitor & Predict Capacity: </strong>Build observability systems that detect bottlenecks, predict usage trends, and optimize resource consumption using tools like Prometheus, ELK, and Grafana.</li> <li><strong>Respond & Lead During Incidents: </strong>Lead incident response and postmortem efforts, applying technical depth to resolve issues and establish operational standards that reduce future risk.</li> <li><strong>Architect & Collaborate: </strong>Influence architectural decisions around automation, scalability, and operational excellence. Partner with engineering teams to improve automation, platform resilience, and production-readiness.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Bring</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Production-Scale Experience: </strong>Proven ability to operate and troubleshoot production workloads across multiple tenants or environments. Deep understanding of how distributed systems fail at scale and how to build in resilience.<br><strong>Terraform & IaC Mastery:</strong> Strong hands-on experience with Terraform, including workspace strategies, state management, and automation patterns that scale. Comfortable solving state isolation issues and building reliable, reusable infrastructure code. Experience with Ansible and templating tools like Jsonnet is a plus.<br><strong>Kubernetes in Production: </strong>Skilled at diagnosing deployment failures, interpreting pod logs, and debugging scheduling issues and rollback scenarios in live environments. Understands how pods, ReplicaSets, and controllers interact in production.<br><strong>Programming & Code Analysis: </strong>Ability to read and debug code in Go and/or Ruby. objectives and indicators, runbooks, and incident response.</li> <li value="3">Experience setting technical direction for observability, reliability, or detection work and bringing other engineers OpenTelemetry.</li> <li value="6">Exposure to analytical data stores such as ClickHouse and the change data capture and event-streaming pipelines that feed them, including NATS JetStream.</li> <li value="7">Experience owning projects from concept through production, communicating clearly about complex technical and organizational problems, and proposing iterative solutions.</li> <li value="8">Working knowledge of Python for anomaly detection and data work, or experience with billing, financial, or other business-critical systems, including Zuora or Salesforce, is a plus.</li> title: AI Systems Engineer (f/m/d)
description: Who is Sonar? Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable. Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code. We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like: SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform. SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair. SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective. Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE: Committed to our customers and community. Obsessed with quality. Deliberate in our decisions. Effective as one team. With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. title: Campaign & Account Manager DACH (all genders) - Mandarin (C2/Native Level)
description: Willkommen bei LunyOne - wir sind eine dynamische Influencer Marketing Agentur, die sich auf Tech, (Mobile-)Gaming, Entertainment und Lifestyle fokussiert. Viele unserer Kunden sind chinesische Tech Brands, deren Entscheidungen im Headquarter in China fallen. Abgestimmt wird über Feishu/Lark und WeChat, auf Mandarin - und genau in dieser Übersetzungsschicht verlieren Agenturen im DACH-Markt normalerweise Zeit und inhaltliche Schärfe. Wir wollen das ändern: mit Dir als direkten Draht zwischen den chinesischen HQs und unseren KOL Kampagnen in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz. Kampagnen steuern: Creator-Auswahl, Timings, Content-Freigaben, Livegang, Reporting. Gemeinsam mit unserem Campaign-Team und mit eigener Verantwortung für Deine Accounts. Erwartungen managen, in beide Richtungen: Du erklärst dem HQ, warum ein Creator hier etwas anders umsetzt, und dem Creator, worauf der Kunde Wert legt. Reportings: Ergebnisse, Learnings und Empfehlungen bereitest Du so auf, dass Entscheidungen im HQ schneller und mit weniger Reibung fallen. Events: gamescom, IFA, Kundentermine (auch in China). Du bist dabei, wenn Brand, Creator und Community zusammenkommen. Account Management (wächst mit Dir) Bringst Du bereits Account-Management Erfahrung mit, kann dieser Teil vom ersten Tag an größer sein. Account-Ownership: Du betreust Deine Kunden über die einzelne Kampagne hinaus, als feste Ansprechperson für das HQ in China und die lokalen Teams. Kulturelle Gaps schließen: Du erkennst früh, wo Erwartungen auseinanderlaufen, und moderierst (kulturelle) Unterschiede bei Feedback-Prozessen, Content-Freigaben und Content-Standards. Statt stur Wort für Wort zu übersetzen, vermittelst Du den Kontext und verhinderst Reibungsverluste, bevor sie entstehen. Planung mit dem HQ: Du stimmst Launch-Kalender, Quartalsplanung und Budgets ab und sorgst dafür, dass DACH über uns als KOL Agentur früh genug im Plan des HQ auftaucht. Potenziale erkennen: Du trackst Budgets und siehst, wo im Account mehr geht: Folgekampagnen, zusätzliche Formate, neue Produktlinien. Pitch und Angebot liegen bei Teamlead und Sales, Du lieferst Kalkulation, Kundenkontext und Deine Einschätzung zu. Den genauen Zuschnitt zwischen beiden Blöcken legen wir gemeinsam im Gespräch fest. Requirements Was Du mitbringen musst Mandarin verhandlungssicher, inklusive Business-Schriftverkehr: Mails, Chat-Nachrichten, Angebote und kurze Präsentationen auf Mandarin formulierst Du sicher und im richtigen Ton. Dazu Deutsch oder sehr sicheres Englisch - mindestens eine der beiden Sprachen verhandlungssicher. Kommerzielles Denken: Budgets, Kalkulationen, Scopes – Du kannst rechnen, weißt, was ein Kampagnen-Euro leisten muss und sagst dem Kunden auch mal freundlich nein. Sicheres Auftreten gegenüber Kunden: Du präsentierst, verhandelst Timings und Umfänge und bleibst auch dann strukturiert, wenn der Kunde am Freitagabend noch eine Änderung schickt. Tech-Affinität: Consumer Electronics, (Gaming-)Hardware, etc. Erste Berufserfahrung in Campaign-, Influencer-, Account- oder Projektmanagement, oder in einer vergleichbaren Schnittstellenrolle zwischen China und Europa. Bereitschaft, remote wie auch vor Ort in Langenfeld zu arbeiten Nice to have Erfahrung in der Kundenbetreuung mit eigener Budget- oder Umsatzverantwortung. Gespür für den deutschen Creator-Markt (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram). Erfahrung mit chinesischen Tech Brands oder Agenturen. Kenntnis chinesischer Plattformen (Xiaohongshu, Bilibili, Douyin, RedNote). Benefits Benefits: Ein motiviertes Team mit flachen Hierarchien und Raum für eigene Ideen, wo Du die Chance hast, Dich selbst zu verwirklichen und zu wachsen - wir pflegen ein familiäres Wachstum Flexible Arbeitszeiten und ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell 28 Urlaubstage Hochwertige technische Ausstattung mit MacBook und iPhone Betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV) bis max 4% der BBG (aktuell 322€/M) - 100% Zuschuss 50€ monatlich über unsere LunyOne Spendit Card Spendit Wellbeing Gleitzeitmodell (Kernarbeitszeit 11:00 – 15:00 Uhr) Jobauto/ Jobrad über Gehaltsumwandlung bKv (300€ Budget/Jahr) Corporate Benefits Relocation Bonus von 964€ Fortbildung/ Upskilling, bis zu ca. 1.200€ p.a. Regelmäßige Team-Events & -Reisen So läuft der Prozess Bewerbung über JOIN: CV plus 3–5 Sätze zu Dir - einmal auf Mandarin, einmal auf Deutsch oder Englisch. Kennenlern-Call mit dem Campaign-Team Gespräch mit Team und Geschäftsführung, dann Angebot. Mission Statement Wir verbinden Brands, Creator und Communities für echten, nachhaltigen Erfolg. Du wirst in einem energiegeladenen Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen arbeiten. Wir suchen daher eine proaktive Persönlichkeit mit Hands-on-Mentalität, die Teil eines beweglichen Teams sein wird, das schnell auf neue Trends reagiert. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung und darauf, Dich kennenzulernen! Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Gestionnaire d'Images - Manip Radio H/F - CDD

Surveiller les métriques opérationnelles et soutenir la priorisation des projets pour respecter les délais et les objectifs de qualité. Fournir des mises à jour sur l'état des projets aux membres seniors de l'équipe et aux parties prenantes. Garantir le respect des procédures internes, des normes de qualité et des meilleures pratiques de l'industrie. Contribuer aux améliorations de processus, aux initiatives de formation et à la gestion des écarts. Compétences Connaissance des modalités d'imagerie médicale et des flux de travail d'imagerie. title: Café Marketing Manager (f/d/m)
description: Hi! We are Coffee Circle, Germany’s leading sustainable specialty coffee roastery based in Berlin. We offer the world’s finest coffee and equipment to over 150,000 customers online and in our Cafés, driven by our goal to make high-end coffee experiences enjoyable and accessible to all. We foster direct trade relationships with coffee farmers worldwide, pay high prices for the coffee beans, and ensure everyone involved in the value chain gets treated fairly and respectfully. For every kilogram of coffee we sell, we invest € 1 through our Coffee Circle Foundation e.V. to help support sustainable improvements in coffee-growing areas, such as providing clean drinking water, hygiene training, and coffee labs. With over 5 million euros raised in donations, we cannot wait to increase our positive impact with you on our team, one cup of coffee at a time. Your role: Execute café-related communication to customers, both in our cafés and online, in line with our brand positioning – from POS materials to newsletters, website content and Google Maps. Make sure our cafés’ offerings are easy to discover, understand and purchase. You’ll shape how we present them on the shelf and at the POS, and contribute to product ideas, seasonal offers, bundles and menu optimization. Plan and bring to life café campaigns, promotions, events and new openings that create a great customer experience and get people excited to join in. Build local partnerships and activations that connect our cafés with their neighborhoods and give customers more reasons to come back. Report to our Head of Marketing and work closely with Retail Operations, Brand, Design, CRM and Category Management to turn ideas into reality. Your profile: You bring at least 2-3 years of experience in a generalist marketing role, with hands-on responsibility for offline, physical products or retail environments. You understand how product presentation, communication, and storytelling can shape the customer experience and drive sales. You combine creative ideas with a hands-on mindset and enjoy taking concepts from idea to execution. You have a strong eye for brand, design and detail, and know how to keep communication clear and consistent. You’re comfortable working across teams, coordinating different stakeholders and keeping things moving. You’re curious, commercially minded and always looking for ways to make the café experience better. You communicate confidently in English; German is a strong plus. What you get from us: Hybrid working for our office team: we have a good balance between working remotely and spending time together in the office, with Berlin as our shared basecamp. You can work remotely for up to nine weeks per year without being physically present in the office. Flexible working hours, with core working hours from 9:30 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. Your Deutschlandticket for public transport is fully covered after your probation period. The opportunity to join our company pension scheme after your probation period. Discounts on our coffee and equipment, as well as access to online discount platforms such as Corporate Benefits and FutureBens. Access to platforms supporting mental and physical well-being, such as nilo. After one year with the company, employees also gain access to the pxtra benefits platform, which includes options such as Urban Sports Club Business M. The best coffee is always available to you, plus quarterly coffee vouchers so you can enjoy your favourite coffee at home with the people you love. A friendly and enjoyable working environment, as well as regular cross-functional team events. We are a purpose-driven organisation. For us, growth means increasing our social impact within coffee-growing communities around the world while opening up a whole new world of coffee for our customers. We strongly believe in authenticity and empathy as the foundation for building strong and innovative teams. We foster a humble and playful mindset and aim to create a continuous learning experience for everyone on our team. Regardless of your ethnic background, skin colour, ancestry, religion, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity: if the job description sounds like a good fit for you, we can’t wait to hear from you. title: Responsable bourses et mobilité internationale F/H
description: Vos missions Vous assurez la gestion des dispositifs de financement de la mobilité internationale des étudiants et des personnels et contribuez au pilotage de celui-ci. Vous garantissez la qualité, la conformité et le suivi administratif et financier des dispositifs de bourses, notamment dans le cadre du programme Erasmus+. En complément de cette mission principale, vous contribuez à la mise en œuvre des engagements de l’UTC dans le cadre de la Charte Erasmus+ et de ses grandes priorités, inclusion et diversité, transition écologique, transformation numérique, participation à la vie démocratique et aux valeurs européennes. Dans ce cadre, vous participez au développement d’actions à destination des étudiants et des personnels : événements, actions de sensibilisation, formations courtes, ressources et formations en ligne. En tant que référent-e « Transition numérique » Erasmus+ de la DRI, vous accompagnez également la transformation numérique des processus de mobilité et participez activement au déploiement, au paramétrage fonctionnel et à l’appropriation du logiciel de gestion de la mobilité internationale et des partenariats universitaires au sein de la DRI. Vos activités 1. Coordonner l’activité du pôle « Bourses » Assurer la gestion des différents dispositifs de financement de la mobilité internationale des étudiants et des personnels Coordonner la gestion des bourses Erasmus+ et des autres dispositifs de financement nationaux, régionaux ou institutionnels Organiser et promouvoir les bourses de mobilités internationales (campagnes d’attribution des aides, information et accompagnement des étudiants et personnels) Assurer le suivi administratif et financier des dossiers de bourses de mobilité internationale et budgets dédiés Produire les données, indicateurs, bilans et statistiques Garantir le respect des critères d’éligibilité, des procédures et des règles propres aux différents programmes Participer à la définition et à l’évolution des critères et procédures, dans une logique de simplification, de fiabilisation et d’amélioration continue. Contribuer aux rapports Erasmus+, aux bilans institutionnels ainsi qu’aux contrôles et audits éventuels Assurer une veille sur l’évolution des dispositifs de financement de la mobilité internationale 2. Accompagner le déploiement de la solution numérique dédiée à la gestion de la mobilité internationale et la transformation numérique des processus Dans le cadre du déploiement de cet outil à l’UTC, vous participez à la transformation et à la dématérialisation des processus de gestion de la mobilité internationale. À ce titre, vous contribuez notamment au/à l’: Déploiement de la solution numérique : analyse des processus existants, workflows, tests, paramétrage… Amélioration régulière : cohérence, fiabilité des données, évolution Accompagnement des membres du service : prise en main, tutoriels Accompagnement des étudiants et personnels Développement d’une utilisation experte progressive : indicateurs et suivi… Vous participez ainsi à faire de la solution numérique un outil d’amélioration et de transformation des processus. 3. Contribuer à la mise en œuvre des priorités de la Charte Erasmus+ Contribuer à la déclinaison opérationnelle des engagements de l’UTC dans le cadre de la Charte Erasmus+ et de ses quatre grandes priorités : Inclusion et diversité : favoriser l’accès à la mobilité des publics ayant moins d’opportunités et améliorer leur accompagnement. Transition écologique : promouvoir une mobilité internationale plus responsable et sensibiliser aux enjeux environnementaux. Transformation numérique : développer les usages et ressources numériques liés à la mobilité et accompagner la dématérialisation des dispositifs Erasmus+. Participation et citoyenneté européenne : développer des actions favorisant la connaissance de l’Europe, de ses valeurs et des opportunités offertes par Erasmus+. 4. Contribuer à la promotion des actions et événements à destination des étudiants Contribuer à la promotion de la mobilité internationale et des priorités Erasmus+ : événements étudiants (Erasmus Days, rencontres interculturelles, témoignages, challenges, etc.) ; ateliers de préparation au départ et de valorisation du retour de mobilité ; actions autour de l’Europe, de l’inclusion, de l’interculturalité et de la mobilité durable. 5. Contribuer au développement des formations courtes et des ressources pédagogiques Contribuer à la conception et à l’animation de formations courtes, ateliers et ressources pédagogiques, en présentiel, en ligne ou en format hybride, dans le contexte de la mission (tutoriels et ressources numériques destinés aux étudiants et personnels). 6. Participer aux projets transversaux de la DRI Participer, selon les besoins, aux projets transversaux de la Direction aux Relations Internationales : projets Erasmus+, alliance européenne SUNRISE, événements internationaux, actions de promotion de la mobilité, internationalisation des formations et démarches d’amélioration continue Travailler en interaction avec les autres pôles de la DRI, les services et enseignants de l’UTC, les associations étudiantes et les partenaires institutionnels. Informations complémentaires Dates pour candidater Du 29/09/2026 au 29/10/2026 Type de recrutement et date prévisionnelle de recrutement Poste ouvert aux personnels de catégorie A assistant ingénieur, par voie statutaire (mutation, détachement) ou contractuelle (contrat à durée déterminée d’un an, prolongation possible pouvant aboutir à un CDI) – pourvoi immédiat Salaire mensuel brut Suivant statut ou par la voie contractuelle, selon expérience Pour les fonctionnaires, RIFSEEP : ASI - Groupe 1 Pour les agents contractuels, salaire mensuel brut de 1 867 euros à 3 111 euros, selon expérience Volume horaire 37 heures et 30 minutes/semaine - 1 607 heures/an Congés 50 jours de congés, RTT comprise, par année universitaire Environnement et contexte de travail Vous intégrerez la direction aux relations internationales et serez placé(e) sous la responsabilité hiérarchique de la directrice aux relations internationales. Des déplacements occasionnels (formations, réunions, évènements) sont à prévoir. Contexte L’ouverture à l’international constitue un pilier du modèle pédagogique de l’UTC et ce depuis sa création. Elle se traduit par une stratégie internationale ambitieuse, des projets d’envergure comme des campus à l’international et une alliance des universités européennes et d’autres projets et partenariats structurants. L’UTC a aujourd’hui plus de 220 partenaires internationaux dans le monde. Certains de ces partenariats ont plus de 40 ans d’existence. L’UTC continue à consolider un réseau européen solide et vise à être un acteur clé dans l’évolution du modèle de l’enseignement supérieur européen. Dans ce cadre, l’établissement vise une mobilité internationale sortante de 100% des étudiants de l’UTC. La mobilité Erasmus+ s’envisage dans ce contexte de la promotion de la mobilité, à la gestion des bourses associés jusqu’aux retours de la mobilité. Pour renforcer cette mobilité, nous accompagnons les étudiantes et étudiants de l’UTC dans l’ensemble des démarches y compris l’obtention des bourses de mobilité internationale. Finalement, la direction aux relations internationales vise également à promouvoir l’interculturalité, renforcer l’inclusion, la digitalisation et la transition environnementale et ce dans le respect des priorités de la charte Erasmus+ et celles de la stratégie de l’UTC. La personne recrutée pourrait contribuer à proposer et développer des actions pour l’implémentation des priorités de la charte Erasmus+ à l’UTC. Bonne maîtrise professionnelle de l’anglais permettant d’interagir avec les étudiants et partenaires internationaux et de travailler sur la documentation Erasmus+. title: STAGE - Junior SRE (Foundation squad)

title: Principal, EMEA Sales Strategy and Operations
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: London, the UK</strong></p> <p><strong>About the Role: </strong></p> <p>As the Principal, EMEA Sales Strategy and Operations, you will lead the operational strategy and execution for two of our most important regions in EMEA. Reporting directly to the Senior Director of Sales Strategy and Operation for EMEA, you will partner closely with regional sales leadership, global sales operations, marketing, finance, and other cross-functional teams to drive sales productivity, accelerate pipeline growth, and enhance forecasting accuracy.</p> <p>You will identify, design, and execute strategies that improve performance, scalability, and operational excellence across UKI, CEE and Israel regions. A catalyst for action, you will bring structure, insight, and momentum to a rapidly growing business. The ideal candidate is both process- and data-driven, thrives on collaboration, and knows how to unite teams around a common vision to deliver exceptional results. </p> <h4><strong>What you'll do</strong></h4> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as a business partner to the UKI, CEE and Israel AVPs and Sales Leadership team, defining and driving strategic initiatives that enable the region to achieve its quarterly and annual revenue objectives. You will deliver actionable insights, analytics, and use AI to enhance decision-making, uncover performance bottlenecks, and accelerate sales execution</li> <li>You will work to continuously improve processes, innovate and find scalable solutions to do more with less. You will use AI and automation to improve sales productivity and help leadership look behind corners to anticipate blockers and reduce risks. </li> <li>Partner with other Regional Leaders, global RevOps, Marketing Ops, Finance and Enablement to ensure regional execution aligns with global go-to-market strategy and expectations</li> <li>Drive forecasting discipline: ensure accurate pipeline coverage, risk identification, deal reviews, and business reviews with regional leadership</li> <li>Monitor region-specific market dynamics and ensure sales operations are tailored to the unique UKI, CEE and Israel environment</li> <li>Own key regional sales operations metrics (e.g., sales cycle length, win rate, pipeline conversion, average deal size, forecasting accuracy, quota attainment) and provide regular reporting to senior leadership and support EMEA sales Strategy and Operations leader to improve cadences.</li> <li>Partner with GTM strategy team and provide input to sales planning, including regular updates to quotas, customer segmentation, account targeting, and Channel development</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Proven senior experience (10+ years) in sales operations, revenue operations or go-to-market operations in a high-growth technology / SaaS company </li> <li>Experience scaling sales operations across multiple regions (preferably EMEA) including complexity of multiple countries, languages, regulatory frameworks</li> <li>Strong analytical skills and comfort working with data: able to turn data into insights and actions</li> <li>Deep understanding of sales processes/end-to-end sales lifecycle, pipeline management best practices, forecasting, territory/quota design, incentive comp, CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce)</li> <li>Experience to use AI to drive automation, innovation and improve efficiency.</li> <li>Exceptional cross-functional collaboration and influencing skills: ability to partner with sales leadership, marketing, product, finance, enablement and others</li> <li>Excellent communication (verbal & written) — able to articulate complex operational issues and influence senior leadership</li> <li>Comfortable working in fast-paced, dynamic, changing environment; strong change-management aptitude</li> <li>Strategic thinking with strong execution orientation</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Audio-Visual (AV) & IT Engineer (m/w/d) UBS Digital Art Museum, Hamburg

Ouster, Hokuyo) und deren Integration in Software-Frameworks Das ist ein Plus: Zertifizierungen: Branchenzertifikate wie AVIXA CTS/CTS-D, Network+ oder CCNA Herstellerschulungen: Spezifische Trainings (z. B. Q-SYS ,Epson, Panasonic, Audinate Dante) Software-Kenntnisse: Erfahrung mit interaktiver Software oder Medienservern (z. B. Touch Designer, Unity, Unreal Engine) Benefits Wir bieten Dir: Eine verantwortungsvolle Rolle in einem außergewöhnlichen Kulturprojekt mit hoher Sichtbarkeit Einen unbefristeten Arbeitsplatz in Vollzeit Ein spannendes, technologisch anspruchsvolles Umfeld mit internationalen Partnern Eine attraktive, marktgerechte Vergütung Ein offenes, wertschätzendes Arbeitsklima mit flexibel versetzten Arbeitszeiten im technischen Team von 6-8 Personen Wenn Du Lust hast, an etwas mitzuwirken, das Menschen bewegt und begeistert, dann bewirb Dich jetzt bei uns. title: Senior Frontend Engineer (Berlin)
description: GeneralMind builds AI Systems of Action for complex enterprise workflows. We deploy AI employees that automate messy operational handovers across supply chains - processing orders, validating invoices, coordinating suppliers, and handling exceptions directly on top of enterprise systems like SAP, Oracle, JDE, and Dynamics. Our platform combines AI agents, operational context graphs, and real transaction data to achieve Autopilot-grade automation in real operational environments. We work closely with leading global companies across manufacturing, retail, and logistics to deploy AI into mission-critical workflows. - Aufgaben Engineering & Architecture Take full ownership of frontend systems from scoping through delivery — you ask the right questions early, cut through ambiguity, and drive things to completion. Make and defend architectural decisions that balance shipping velocity with long-term maintainability; you know when to build a custom component and when to reach for a proven pattern. Build fast, accessible, and reliable interfaces with React and Next.js as your primary stack, with enough full-stack range to collaborate effectively across Python-based backend services. Evaluate AI tooling critically — you use it daily to move faster, but you understand that vibe coding is a liability, and you hold your AI-generated output to the same standard as everything else. Technical Leadership Lead your squad during planning cycles: go deep on each ticket, challenge scope where needed, and make sure the team ships with clarity. Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through code review, pairing, and design discussions — not by micromanaging, but by setting a high bar. Proactively identify bottlenecks, technical debt, and systemic risks before they become emergencies. - Qualifikation Experience: 8+ years of hands-on frontend engineering experience, with a consistent track record of shipping production applications at scale. Technical depth: TypeScript and React are non-negotiable. Deep experience with Next.js (App Router, server components, data fetching patterns) is expected. title: Backend Software Engineer - Indexing
description: About us: DeepJudge is Switzerland’s leading AI and ICT scale-up, transforming how law firms and legal departments access and leverage their knowledge. Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, and backed by top-tier Silicon Valley investors, we are building the intelligence layer that powers the legal industry. Every firm can license the same AI models, but no two firms share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often trapped across systems, underused and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure, enabling firms to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn experience into a lasting advantage. Our technology is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms, including Freshfields, Gunderson Dettmer, Holland & Knight, Arent Fox, and Cozen O’Connor. Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America, we are expanding rapidly and shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied. At DeepJudge, we move fast, think rigorously, and care deeply about what we build. We combine cutting-edge research with close collaboration with our clients to deliver solutions that truly make an impact. If you want to be part of a team defining how AI transforms high-stakes knowledge work, this is the place to do it. About the Role: We’re looking for a Backend Software Engineer to join our team and take meaningful ownership from day one. You’ll work closely with smart, driven, and genuinely fun people who are passionate about tackling the complex challenges involved in building a high-performance product at scale. Our indexing system is the backbone of our search engine, processing queries over hundreds of millions of documents in fractions of a second. Building and maintaining these indices within tight time and resource constraints requires highly performant, scalable software. To achieve this, we rely on modern technologies in distributed and parallel computing, database systems, and cloud platforms. You’ll leverage the strengths of these technologies to meet demanding throughput and latency requirements. Your responsibilities will include: Design, develop, and maintain efficient, scalable backend services using modern tools and frameworks Take ownership of core components of our indexing infrastructure Collaborate with other engineers to define, design, and ship new features Optimize performance and scalability across our data processing pipelines Integrate with third-party data providers and effectively use their APIs Review code and contribute to a high standard of code quality and maintainability Participate in agile development processes, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives You're a great fit if you: Have a Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience Have 2+ years of experience as a Backend Software Engineer, ideally in a scale-up or fast-growing environment Have strong experience with concurrent and parallel programming and understand how to write correct, efficient code under load Are highly proficient in Python, our primary backend language. Solid experience with Rust or Go is also very welcome, even if Python isn't your strongest language yet Have solid experience working with databases (SQL and/or NoSQL) Are comfortable with modern web architectures and cloud platforms Enjoy solving complex problems and thinking about performance at scale Communicate clearly and enjoy working in a collaborative team Take ownership and can work independently when needed Have experience with information retrieval or search systems (nice to have) What you can look forward to: Location: Office 5min walking distance from Zurich central station, where we primarily work on site Collaborative and supportive work environment Potential for professional growth and advancement within the company Ownership and ability to impact the company, product, and culture At DeepJudge, we believe great teams are built on diverse perspectives and experiences.
