title: Software Engineer - Delta Platform
description: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. About the role Delta builds BLP’s core software: the technical foundation that everything else at the company runs on. Who we're looking for Modelling logic and correctness by construction is paramount to us. We aim to express what must be true, prevent invalid states, and keep systems pristine even as they grow. Thus, we’re looking for highly ambitious engineers who can tackle difficult problems and think precisely. You must be able to make assumptions explicit and use formal, structured reasoning to reach a solution, and explain why it is correct. Typically, strong background in mathematics is a key foundation for this kind of work. We also place a high value on thoroughness and perfectionism. Tooling wise, we rely heavily on type systems & functional programming. What you'll do Our work spans four areas, you will usually work on a given project within one of: Infrastructure: Build and operate the cloud infrastructure BLP depends on, covering security, observability and CI/CD. Backend: Develop a large codebase, tackling performance, concurrency and the challenges of distributed systems. ML: Apply the latest AI technology to complex, real-world business problems and turn it into reliable production software. Unbound: Build our product extension platform, enabling BLP to automate arbitrary customer business processes as we scale. What you'll bring We do not require experience with any particular technology or even industry software development experience. You should, however, provide clear evidence of the abilities we’re looking for. That evidence could include: strong academic backgrounds (math PhD/MSc or significant olympiad achievements) startup experience (early employee, built productive systems yourself & know what it takes to maintain them) FP experience (have deep understanding of programming languages and are able to discern the various tradeoffs of different paradigms) What we value We value engineers who think deeply about systems, care about correctness, and take pride in building infrastructure that is understandable, maintainable, and reliable. Flexibility. Work on-site in Zurich or remotely within Europe. Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers . Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: (Junior) Energy Data Scientist – Energiedaten & Automatisierung (MSB) (m/w/d)
description: Über uns Bei VREY bauen wir das EnergyOS für Mehrfamilienhäuser . In Deutschland stehen über 3,3 Millionen Mehrparteienhäuser – und sie sind das schwarze Loch der Energiewende. <1% Solardurchdringung. <2% Smart Metering. Kaum Flexibilität oder intelligentes Energiemanagement. Gleichzeitig zwingt die Regulierung Eigentümer zu massiven Investitionen: Solar wird zur Pflicht, Smart Meter müssen in den nächsten 5 Jahren flächendeckend ausgerollt werden, Heizung und Mobilität elektrifizieren sich. Das Mehrfamilienhaus wird vom Betongold zum aktiven Teil der dezentralen Energieinfrastruktur. Was fehlt, ist ein integriertes System, das diesen Wandel wirtschaftlich und operativ beherrschbar macht. VREY kombiniert zertifizierten Messstellenbetrieb mit eigener Software und ermöglicht Eigentümern erstmals, ihren selbst erzeugten Solarstrom direkt an ihre Mieter zu verkaufen – einfach und ohne selbst zum Energieversorger zu werden (§42b EnWG). Damit wird regulatorischer Zwang zu einer profitablen und planbaren Chance: Zweistellige Renditen und Wertsteigerung für Eigentümer, ~20 % Stromkostenersparnis für Mieter, und digitale Infrastruktur für Speicher, Wärmepumpen und Flexibilität. Bereits heute betreuen wir eine dreistellige Anzahl an Projekten - darunter die größten Bestandshalter und Wohnungsbaugenossenschaften - in allen 16 Bundesländern. Damit gehören wir nach kürzester Zeit zu den führenden Anbietern im Markt. Im Zuge unserer Seed-Finanzierung haben wir 3,3 Mio. € von führenden Impact- und Energy-VCs (u. a. Rubio Impact Ventures, HTGF, Kopa Ventures) eingesammelt. Mit dem frischen Kapital gehen wir in die nächste Wachstumsphase und bauen unser Team gezielt aus. Wir stehen am Anfang eines strukturellen Marktumbruchs. Wer heute die Energieinfrastruktur im Mehrfamilienhaus definiert, prägt sie für Jahrzehnte. Werde Teil von VREY und baue mit uns das führende EnergyOS. Dein Profil Du hast bereits erste Erfahrungen im Consulting (Tier 1/Tier 2) , High-Growth Start-ups ( idealerweise Operations oder Prozessoptimierung), oder im Projektmanagement gesammelt und ein abgeschlossenes Studium in einem relevanten Bereich Erfahrung oder starkes Interesse an Datenanalyse, Automatisierung und KI/LLM-Agents (z. B. Python, APIs, Umgang mit größeren Datenmengen) Sehr gutes Zahlen- und Datenverständnis ; Freude daran, Datenqualitätsprobleme systematisch und datenbasiert zu durchdringen Idealerweise Erfahrung in der Energiewirtschaft / Marktkommunikation (MaKo, Messstellenbetrieb, GGV/Mieterstrom, Bilanzierung) - oder die klare Bereitschaft, sich schnell tief einzuarbeiten. Strukturierte, gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise: du gibst dich nicht mit „Job abgeschlossen" zufrieden, sondern prüfst, ob das Ergebnis inhaltlich stimmt Eigenverantwortung und Ownership-Mentalität: du übernimmst einen Bereich, statt nur Aufgaben abzuarbeiten; und strebst danach, dein volles Potenzial in diesem Bereich zu entfalten Du suchst bewusst keinen 9-to-5-Job, sondern willst in einem schnelllebigen, gründer-nahen Umfeld Verantwortung übernehmen, Strukturen aufbauen und das Wachstum aktiv mitgestalten Du bist in Berlin (oder bereit umzuziehen) - unser Büro ist unser Homebase Du sprichst Deutsch und Englisch fließend Deine Aufgaben Mission der Rolle Du sitzt an einer unternehmenskritischen Schnittstelle: tief drin im operativen Energiedaten-Geschäft und mit dem Mandat, dieses Geschäft durch eigene Datenanalysen, Tools und KI-Agenten grundlegend zu automatisieren. Du siehst den unmittelbaren Effekt deiner Arbeit - jedes gelöste Ticket bringt ein Projekt näher an die Abrechnung, jeder gebaute Agent spart dem ganzen Team Zeit. 1. Datenanalyse & Automatisierung durch eigene KI-Agents Du analysierst Messwerte, Zählerstände und Versandjobs auf Muster, Ausreißer und wiederkehrende Fehlerursachen Du übersetzt dieses Wissen in KI-Agenten, die Fehler eigenständig diagnostizieren und Lösungswege vorschlagen oder umsetzen Du bist der fachliche Motor der Messstellenbetrieb (MSB) App: du erkennst aus dem Tagesgeschäft, welche Features fehlen, spezifizierst sie und bringst sie mittels eigener Entwicklung ins Produkt 2. Operative Energiedaten-Verantwortung bis zur Abrechnungsreife Du bringst Projekte Monat für Monat zur Abrechnungsreife: fehlende oder unplausible Messwerte korrigieren, Ersatzwerte über Referenzprofile bilden, Werte maskieren und neu berechnen lassen Du legst Versandjobs an, überwachst deren Status und plausibilisierst die Daten nach jedem Fix Du arbeitest dabei täglich in der App unserer Partner und unserer internen MSB App entlang der marktüblichen MSB-Prozesse 3. Ownership & Skalierung des MSB-Bereichs Du verantwortest alle Energiedaten-Tickets intern (Projekt- und Abrechnungsteams) wie extern (VNB, Lieferanten, ÜNB) - von Annahme über Priorisierung bis Lösung - und bist Eskalationsinstanz bei komplexen Fällen Du behältst die MSB-relevanten Postfächer im Blick, ordnest Nachrichten von Marktpartnern den richtigen Vorgängen zu und stellst sicher, dass keine fristrelevante Kommunikation untergeht Du lernst Praktikant:innen und Werkstudent:innen in Prozesse, Tools und die MSB Bibel ein, begleitest sie bis zur Eigenständigkeit und hältst die Doku aktuell Benefits Verantwortung: zentrale Rolle in unserem Kernteam Vergütung: Kompetitives Gehalt und Anteile am Unternehmen Startdatum: so bald wie möglich, unbefristet Team & Benefits: Lustiges Team, Tech Budget von 2 Tsd.€, regelmäßige Team Events und Learning Lunches, Gratis Getränke, Deutschlandticket Weitere Vorteile: Tägliche Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern, Getränke & Snacks, Personalverantwortung und die Möglichkeit, das Unternehmen von Grund auf mitzugestalten Das Wichtigste: Du brennst für Unternehmertum und Start-ups. Bei uns entstehen keine endlosen Slide-Decks oder rein theoretische Modelle – wir bauen ein Unternehmen und machen tagtäglich einen großen Schritt nach vorne. Wenn du von Tag 1 an etwas Großem mitgestalten möchtest, bist du bei uns genau richtig. Noch ein paar Worte zum Schluss Bei VREY sind wir davon überzeugt, dass Vielfalt uns als Unternehmen und Gesellschaft stärkt . title: Automation Engineer, Wet Lab
description: Role summary: At Differential Bio, our mission is to unlock the potential of the bioeconomy by fixing how biological R&D and scale-up are done . Today, bioprocess development is slow, expensive, and limited by the economics of lab hardware. A typical system runs 4, 8, or 24 bioreactors in parallel, and a single run can cost anywhere from hundreds to several thousand dollars. Our ambition is different: 100 parallel bioreactor runs at around $10 per run. Why does that matter? Because radically reducing the cost per insight changes what is possible. Instead of running a handful of carefully selected experiments, we can generate dense, standardized datasets across thousands of conditions. That data is at the core of Differential Bio. First, we automate high-throughput data generation. Then we use our proprietary datasets to train AI models that understand how bioprocesses behave across conditions and scales - with the long-term goal of building a digital twin of fermentation at any scale . We have already built two end-to-end automated fermentation pods that operate continuously and generate experimental data every week. Being vertically integrated all the way down to the physical lab has proven to be a major advantage for us. Now we are hiring the first role dedicated entirely to lab automation . You will take over this domain from our founder and CTO, Martin, report directly to him, and own how our automation platform develops from here. This is, in many ways, the role we always wished existed : high autonomy, genuinely difficult engineering problems, the freedom and resources to solve them properly, and a mission worth the hard work. This is not a role for someone who wants to select the next six-figure laboratory automation system from a catalogue. We want someone who looks at a €500,000 solution and asks: Why does this cost €500,000? What problem are we actually solving? And could we achieve the same outcome - or a better one - for a fraction of the cost and at 10x the scale? Sometimes the answer will be an established lab instrument. Sometimes it will be an industrial robot, a €50 sensor, a 3D-printed part, and some clever engineering. Your opportunity is to help us completely rethink how lab automation is done and build the infrastructure that makes biological R&D dramatically faster and cheaper. Key responsibilities: Own lab automation at Differential Bio end-to-end, from creating individual components to developing complete new automated fermentation systems, including technical decisions, experimentation, suppliers, and budget. Drive our ambition to dramatically increase experimental density while reducing the cost per experiment and cost per insight. Translate wet-lab workflows into reliable, scalable automation together with our scientists, software engineers, and ML engineers. Make pragmatic build vs. buy vs. modify decisions instead of defaulting to expensive, closed laboratory automation platforms. Prototype and build yourself: fermentation pods and small bioreactors, using 3D printing & our workshop. Evaluate and integrate robots, liquid handling systems, and emerging automation technologies, working directly with manufacturers to adapt or co-develop around our requirements. Continuously improve reliability, throughput, maintainability, and cost as our automation platform scales. Qualifications: We care more about how you solve engineering problems than about a specific degree or career path. You should: Have evidence of excellence: 4+ years of experience in lab automation, robotics, or other automation projects involving real hardware - or an equivalent track record of serious hobby projects where you have built, modified, automated, and debugged physical systems yourself. Be a tinkerer : someone who enjoys opening the box, understanding how something works, modifying it, and building something better when necessary. Be comfortable with robotics, sensors, actuators, mechanical design, electronics, embedded systems, or related technologies. Be able to move quickly between disciplines and collaborate with wet-lab scientists, automation specialists, software engineers, and ML engineers. Be comfortable with ambiguity and high autonomy. We define outcomes; you have substantial freedom to determine how to achieve them. Combine creative engineering with a strong focus on reliability and repeatability. Experience with laboratory automation, bioreactors, liquid handling, CAD, 3D printing, Python, PLCs, machine vision, or industrial automation is a plus - but not a requirement. This is a demanding job. The problems are hard, the ownership is real, and there will not always be a playbook to follow. We are looking for someone who enjoys that responsibility rather than avoids it. We want to see the fire in you : the curiosity, energy, and determination to keep digging until something works. Benefits: Build something fundamentally new: Help move lab automation away from boutique, over-engineered systems toward high-density biological data factories. High ownership: Own our lab automation stack, technical direction, suppliers, and significant parts of the automation budget. Real freedom to build: We have 3D printers, workshop capabilities, testing space, and the budget to buy robots and hardware when experimentation requires it. Direct impact: Work closely with our founder and CTO and shape one of Differential Bio's core technological advantages. title: Senior Sales & Business Development Manager, Asia-Pacific (m/f/x)
description: Your way into the future Shape the Future of Global Connectivity At Mynaric, we're building the optical fiber for the skies. As a pioneer in laser communications, we develop cutting-edge technology that enables ultra-fast, secure, and reliable data transmission between satellites, aircraft, drones, and terrestrial platforms. Our solutions are helping shape the future of aerospace, defense, and global communications networks. We are looking for an ambitious and commercially driven Senior Sales & Business Development Manager, Asia-Pacific to accelerate our growth across one of the world's most dynamic aerospace and defense markets. This is more than a sales role. You will be the driving force behind expanding Mynaric's presence across Asia-Pacific, developing strategic customer relationships, identifying major business opportunities, and transforming qualified prospects into long-term partnerships. You will engage directly with senior executives, government stakeholders, defense organizations, system integrators, and innovative commercial space companies that are shaping the future of connectivity. Just as importantly, you will remain actively involved after contract award, working closely with our Customer Project Manager and Project Leads to ensure customer expectations, program execution, and business objectives remain aligned throughout the customer journey. Acting as a trusted advisor, you will help customers understand how Mynaric's technology can support their strategic and operational objectives while creating opportunities for sustainable business growth. title: Senior UI/UX Designer (all genders)
description: Über ]init[ Du möchtest die Gesellschaft von morgen mitgestalten? Dann bist du bei ]init[ richtig. Deine Mission bei ]init[ Als Senior UI/UX Designer (all genders) verantwortest du in interdisziplinären Projektteams die visuelle Gestaltung anspruchsvoller Fachanwendungen, Portale und Informationsangebote – im Public- und Health-Sector ebenso wie in regulierten Branchen der Privatwirtschaft, etwa im Energiesektor. Du gibst komplexen digitalen Produkten eine klare, eigenständige und hochwertige visuelle Sprache. Von der übergeordneten visuellen Leitidee über Layout, Typografie und visuelle Hierarchie bis hin zur Ausarbeitung von Komponenten, Interaktionen und Zuständen. Designsysteme sind für dich dabei kein Nebenprodukt, sondern das Rückgrat deiner Arbeit: Du baust sie auf, hältst sie über Produkte hinweg konsistent und sorgst dafür, dass sie in der Entwicklung tatsächlich ankommen. description: Du willst AI Agents nicht nur konzipieren, sondern in reale Systeme und Kundenprozesse bringen? Du verbindest AI-Agent-Plattformen mit bestehenden Unternehmenssystemen, übersetzt fachliche Prozesse in robuste Agent- und Conversation-Flows und sorgst dafür, dass die Lösung zuverlässig funktioniert. Du musst dafür kein ausgewiesener LLM-Forscher sein. Wichtig ist, dass du bereits praktische Erfahrung mit Software, APIs oder technischen Implementierungen hast, komplexe Probleme strukturiert zerlegst und dich schnell in neue Technologien einarbeitest. Die Rolle verbindet Solution Architecture, Integration Engineering und Conversational AI. Du arbeitest hands-on und übernimmst mit wachsender Erfahrung zunehmend Verantwortung für technische Lösungen und Kundenprojekte. Deine Aufgaben: AI-Agent-Lösungen konzipieren: Du entwirfst End-to-End-Lösungen für Chat- und Voice-Agents und übersetzt Kundenanforderungen in klare technische und fachliche Konzepte. APIs implementieren und testen: Du arbeitest mit REST- und gegebenenfalls SOAP-APIs, Webhooks, JSON/XML, Authentifizierungsverfahren und Daten-Mappings. Conversation-Flows entwickeln: Du strukturierst Prozesse so, dass AI Agents sie zuverlässig ausführen können, und setzt Prompts, Regeln, Fallbacks und Eskalationslogiken um. Kundenprojekte begleiten: Du arbeitest direkt mit Ansprechpartnern aus Customer Service, IT und Fachbereichen und erklärst technische Zusammenhänge verständlich. Implementierungen dokumentieren: Du hältst Architekturentscheidungen, Integrationen, Testfälle und Best Practices nachvollziehbar fest. Know-how weiterentwickeln: Du beobachtest neue Entwicklungen rund um LLMs, Agentic AI und Conversational AI und bewertest ihren praktischen Nutzen für unsere Projekte. Technische Tiefe statt Buzzwords: Du arbeitest an Integrationen, Agent-Logik, Testing und Performance-Optimierung und siehst, wie deine Entscheidungen die Lösung beeinflussen. Abwechslungsreiche Projekte: Du arbeitest mit unterschiedlichen Kunden, Systemlandschaften und AI-Agent-Plattformen. Direkter Einfluss: In unserem kleinen Team kannst du Entscheidungen mitgestalten und Themen eigenständig vorantreiben. Lernen mit Verantwortung: Du bekommst Unterstützung, Feedback und den Raum, dein Wissen Schritt für Schritt zu vertiefen. Faire Rahmenbedingungen: Wir bieten ein Jahresbruttogehalt von 45.000 € bis 65.000 € , abhängig von Erfahrung und Verantwortungsumfang. Vor-Ort-Termin mit Oscar und Ludwig – Kennenlernen, Blick ins Team und gemeinsamer Abgleich der Erwartungen. title: Senior Customer Experience Manager - German Speaking
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>About the Department</strong></h3> <p>Renewals Account Managers, Customer Success Managers, Account Executives, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, and Sales Operations - all working together help our customers adopt Cloudflare and create great Internet-enabled experiences.</p> <p>The sales team at Cloudflare helps customers solve real, technical problems while creating the revenue streams that help the company provide free service to millions in our community.</p> <h3><strong>Location: Lisbon, Portugal</strong></h3> <h3><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h3> <p>The Customer Experience Manager leads the post-sale customer journey, managing everything from onboarding to long-term retention and contract renewals. You will collaborate tightly with the Sales team to maintain accurate weekly forecasts and contribute to  critical engagements like Executive Business Reviews. In addition, you will embed AI-driven optimization into your daily workflows—using advanced data analysis to uncover selling opportunities and automating routine tasks to accelerate customer outcomes and maximize operational efficiency.</p> <h3><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h3> <h3>Customer Lifecycle & Success</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Manage customer engagement across the entire customer lifecycle, from onboarding through renewal.</p> </li> <li> <p>Be a Trusted Advisor to your customers by helping them adopt the Cloudflare products and services to meet their needs and make them successful</p> </li> <li> <p>Work with your account teams to plan and execute long term Success Plans with our largest customers to facilitate retention and growth via product and new business unit expansion.</p> </li> <li> <p>Maintain a deep understanding of our solutions and present to customers about the most relevant features/functionality for their specific business needs.</p> </li> <li> <p>Own or be an active participant in several customer touch points including: Business Value Justification meetings, Business Reviews, and Renewal Meetings, with a track record of successful planning and execution of Executive Business Reviews.</p> </li> <li> <p>Demonstrate how your customer engagement directly impacts revenue growth and adoption of Cloudflare solutions and services.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Commercial & Renewals</h3> <ul> <li> <p><strong>You are ultimately responsible for the retention and growth of your book of business. </strong>You will own and drive the renewal including maintaining and reporting an accurate weekly forecast.</p> </li> <li> <p>Negotiate and execute renewal contracts in accordance with customer objectives.</p> </li> <li> <p>You will be an expert in deal construction and pricing strategy. You will directly be designing renewals to create a win-win for customers and Cloudflare. </p> </li> <li> <p>Analyze data and leverage tools to identify selling opportunities and business value.</p> </li> <li> <p>Drive strong alignment with the Sales team, contributing to team forecasting, planning, and targets.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Cross-Functional & Operational Management</h3> <ul> <li> resolve customer business issues and work towards each customer’s stated goals.</p> </li> <li> <p>Manage customer feedback and product needs by providing feature requests to internal partner teams.</p> </li> <li> <p>Able to prioritize effectively to handle multiple deals at the same time.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>AI Competencies</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Generative AI: Mastery of LLMs to rapidly draft renewal communications, synthesize quarterly review data, and prepare executive summaries.</p> </li> <li> <p>Data Analysis: Proficiency in leveraging AI analytics tools to parse customer usage metrics and instantly highlight up-sell or cross-sell opportunities.</p> </li> <li> <p>Workflow Automation: Ability to build automations to synchronize CRM data, update weekly forecasts, and trigger lifecycle alerts.</p> </li> <li> <p>AI Problem Solving: The instinct to view AI as a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward.</p> </li> </ul> <h3><strong>Qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li> <p>Minimum of 3 years of experience in a Customer Success/Account Management role or Inside or Field sales.</p> </li> <li> <p>Fluency in German</p> </li> <li> <p>2+ years of industry experience, with experience in cloud security and/or performance industries preferred.</p> </li> <li> <p>Bachelor's degree and/or other professional qualifications.</p> </li> <li> <p>Direct experience in commercial sales, negotiation, and deal closure.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong understanding of or willingness to learn about computer networking and “how the internet works,” with network security a plus.</p> </li> <li> <p>Manage and prioritize competing portfolio demands, aligning internal resources with the highest-impact commercial and retention goals</p> </li> <li> <p>Expertise in SaaS retention and sales process and excellent knowledge of value driven sales.</p> </li> <li> <p>Excellent problem solving skills with the ability to creatively achieve resolutions.</p> </li> </ul> <h3 data-path-to-node="0"><strong data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">Compensation</strong></h3> <p data-path-to-node="2">● For Portugal based We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More d

description: Location Frankfurt am Main About Us About AllUnity AllUnity is a regulated e-money institute building Europe’s digital payments infrastructure for instant cross-border payments, digital asset markets, and seamless liquidity flows. About the Role We are looking for a Risk Specialist with experience in structured risk management within a regulated financial services environment and a strong interest or exposure to blockchain-based products. title: Senior Customer Engineer, Digital Native Business, Indonesia
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Job Location: Singapore</strong></h3> <h3><strong>What you will do as a Senior Customer Engineer</strong></h3> <p>The Senior Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Validation: </strong>Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. . Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.</li> <li><strong>Customer Adoption & Value Realization: </strong>Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer’s environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance), and act as the lead consultant for customer engineering teams, walking them step-by-step through configuration best practices.  Partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes. </li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: </strong>Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> <li><strong>Education & Enablement:</strong> Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience: 7+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services,  Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer </li> <li>Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly.</li> <li>Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.</li> <li>Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.</li> <li>Technical Breadth: We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every domain. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below:</li> <ul> <li>Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.</li> <li>Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.</li> <li>Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.</li> <li>AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.</li> <li>Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> <li>Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")</strong></p> <ul> <li>Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms. </li> <li>Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls.</li> <li>Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.</li> <li>Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth.</li> <li>This role requires frequent travel to Indonesia and work directly with clients communicate in Bahasa Indonesia. Fluency in Bahasa Indonesia is preferred.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Education</strong></p> <p>Undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. </p> <p><strong>Travel</strong></p> <p>This role may require travel up to 20–50% to attend customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and in-person team collaboration.</p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>This role features a competitive base salary and a variable compensation structure tied directly to the successful execution of full-lifecycle commercial targets, including new business acquisition, ongoing adoption milestones, and overall account expansion.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election infor

title: Director of Product Management, Fintech

Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. title: Software Engineer, Robot Autonomy (Planning & Navigation)
description: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient. We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today! THE ROLE As a Software Engineer on Robot Autonomy, you will make our robots navigate dependably across real customer sites. Our stack works. The gap between working and dependable is the whole job. Every new site tests how a robot understands its surroundings and chooses where to go: a ramp the planner avoids, a narrow passage that exposes a poor route, a gate that changes the map, a person who steps into the robot's path, or localization drift that builds over a long patrol. You treat those cases as the real navigation problem to solve, not as edge cases. You'll shape the technical choices behind reliable navigation, from sensor selection, ground segmentation, and traversability estimation to predicting how people and vehicles move and planning safe, efficient routes around them. The system has to work day and night, in challenging weather, across different embodiments and changing site conditions. We measure success by whether the robot completes its patrol on a live site, not by how it performs in simulation. WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON Navigation and path-planning design: how robots represent traversable space, select routes, avoid obstacles, and reach goals across complex sites. Sensor integration driven by navigation requirements, including what ground segmentation and traversability estimation need in day, night, and challenging weather. Environment understanding: how the robot distinguishes ground from obstacles and estimates which terrain is safe and practical to traverse. Behavior prediction: anticipate how people, vehicles, and other dynamic obstacles will move, and plan routes that stay safe and efficient around them. Field reliability: reproduce failures from deployments, find the root cause, and fix it at the right layer, from sensor data and maps to costmaps, planners, and recovery behaviors. Planning under imperfect localization: plans that stay useful when the state estimate drifts and the robot must execute routes in tight or dynamic environments, working with the rest of Robot Autonomy on localization and control. Validation on real robots: logs, simulation, and repeatable field tests to verify that design choices and changes hold across routes, lighting, weather, and site layouts. New autonomy capabilities: work with the engineers building the operator application and backend so operator requests and new robot capabilities rest on a sound navigation design. The field feedback loop: work closely with forward-deployed engineers to turn site issues into bugs, design changes, and improvements to the navigation stack. Regular site visits to build a practical understanding of how robots and sensors behave in real operating conditions. WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR We're looking for an engineer who has taken a robotics system from unreliable to dependable and takes ownership beyond individual tickets. You can explain why you made a navigation design choice and what it costs. When a robot takes a bad route, you can tell whether the planner, the map, the state estimate, or the robot's behavior is at fault, and you fix the right one. You are comfortable in the field and want to understand how robots behave in real customer environments. YOUR BACKGROUND: A Master's degree or PhD in mechanical engineering, computer science, robotics, electrical engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Proven track record building and deploying navigation on ground mobile robots in the real world (3+ years or equivalent depth). Hands-on experience with mobile robot navigation and path planning: route or local planning, static and dynamic obstacle avoidance, costmaps, or recovery behaviors. Understanding of how mapping and localization affect navigation, and the ability to diagnose when a planning issue is actually caused by the map, the state estimate, or robot behavior. You'll fuse data from IMUs, cameras, LiDAR, GNSS, and platform-specific odometry into accurate, real-time estimates that support reliable autonomy day and night, across different robot platforms. This is a builder's role first: you'll use the estimation methods and tools best suited to the problem, then do the engineering needed to make them work on real robots. Our robots operate in complex environments where terrain, weather, vibration, lighting, and sensor dropouts degrade measurements. We care less about novelty for its own sake and more about whether your systems perform reliably across platforms in the field. WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON Design and ship real-time estimators for position, orientation, velocity, and angular velocity across our robot platforms. Fuse data from multiple sensors, handling noise, asynchronous measurements, calibration errors, changing sensor quality, and dropouts. Develop estimation approaches suited to different platforms, including reusable components and interfaces that account for their distinct sensors and dynamics. Improve localization and odometry in challenging conditions, including GNSS-denied environments and cases with degraded or intermittent sensing. Integrate state estimation with perception, planning, and control so downstream systems receive reliable estimates and useful uncertainty information. Investigate failures using logs, datasets, simulation, and field testing; identify root causes and verify that fixes improve performance on real robots. Build evaluation and testing workflows that make estimator performance measurable and repeatable across robot types and operating conditions. Work closely with the rest of Robot Autonomy and with forward-deployed engineers to turn deployment experience into improvements to the estimation stack. You understand that estimator performance depends on the whole system: sensor behavior, calibration, timing, platform dynamics, and how autonomy uses the estimate. You measure success by whether robots operate reliably in the real world, not by algorithmic novelty alone. YOUR BACKGROUND: A Master's degree or PhD in mechanical engineering, computer science, robotics, electrical engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Strong understanding of nonlinear state estimation, sensor fusion, Kalman filtering, and uncertainty representation. Experience working with real sensor data and practical issues such as noise, calibration, synchronization, vibration, and data loss. Strong C++ and Python skills, with experience building robotics software in ROS 2. Ability to analyze estimation failures and debug issues across sensors, software, and robot behavior. Experience evaluating robotics systems using recorded data, simulation, or physical robots. Strong software engineering practices, including version control, reproducible experiments, and disciplined performance evaluation. Understanding of robot dynamics and how estimation affects planning and control. title: Full Stack Product Engineer (100% Remote - Germany | UK | Ireland)
description: Build analytics people can trust. Help define what analytics looks like in an AI-first world. Most analytics platforms ask organisations to trade control for insight. For almost 20 years, Matomo has shown there is another way: powerful, transparent and trustworthy analytics that respects privacy, gives organisations ownership of their data, and helps people understand what's happening, make better decisions, and improve their work. More than one million websites use Matomo. That means you'll work on software that is widely used, technically demanding, and close enough to customers that your work has a visible impact. It's a rare opportunity for engineers: solving meaningful, complex product problems while seeing the difference your work makes for customers. We are independent, profitable, and open source. We are not trying to become a smaller copy of Big Tech analytics platforms. We are building a different kind of analytics company: one where privacy, transparency, customer control, and product quality are part of the core product, not marketing claims. This role focuses on Matomo Core, the foundation of our product and the platform our open-source users, cloud customers, and wider plugin ecosystem depend on. If you want unusually high ownership, visible impact, hard product & platform problems, and the opportunity to strengthen a widely used open-source platform , Matomo is worth a serious look. Why this role matters Matomo Core is the foundation of our open-source product, cloud platform, plugins, integrations and customer-facing features. It has evolved over many years and operates across a wide range of environments, use cases and data volumes. Every improvement to Core benefits customers, open-source users, plugin developers and engineering teams across the Matomo ecosystem. We are bringing responsibility for Core into a newly formed European team. You'll help shape how this team works, where it focuses and how it creates the greatest impact across Matomo. As a Product Engineer, you’ll help decide where Core can create the greatest impact. That could mean solving a difficult customer problem, strengthening an existing capability, creating a new platform capability, or simplifying the Core platform to make it easier to evolve. You’ll work on a mature and technically complex product. The challenge is not simply to preserve what exists. It is to understand why it exists, recognise where it is holding customers or engineers back, and evolve it without disrupting the open-source users, customers, integrations and plugins that already depend on it. What you’ll own You'll own problems, not just code. This is not a traditional feature-ticket engineering role. You'll understand customer problems, shape solutions, build across the stack, ship incrementally and continuously improve what you release. AI should be part of your everyday workflow. You'll own work from problem to outcome: Understand the problem before committing to a solution. Help shape priorities, not just implement them. Build across the stack wherever the problem takes you. Ship incrementally and learn from real usage. Measure outcomes and iterate. Use AI throughout your workflow. For senior: You'll help shape what we build, not only how we build it. You'll identify opportunities others haven't seen, influence technical and product direction, and help establish how the Core team operates as it grows. For intermediate: You'll contribute to deciding what we build, working closely with product, engineering and customers rather than simply implementing predefined requirements. You'll own meaningful problems end-to-end while building confidence in navigating ambiguity and product trade-offs. What the work looks like You'll work across the Core platform wherever you can create the greatest impact. Examples include: Diagnosing and solving complex problems across a large, mature codebase. Strengthening the security, performance, scalability, reliability and resilience of Matomo. Protecting the integrity, accuracy and trustworthiness of the data customers rely on. Strengthen capabilities that support increasingly demanding enterprise use cases. Building and evolving APIs and platform capabilities used by Matomo plugins and integrations. Evolving how Matomo handles consent, privacy and responsible data collection. Advancing server-side tracking, data anonymisation and data-health monitoring. Enhancing analytics capabilities such as goals, ecommerce reporting and dashboards. Simplifying complex analytics workflows and making powerful functionality easier to use. Evolving Matomo's design system to create a more consistent and usable product experience. How we work We’re a small team competing with companies many times our size. That means we optimise for impact. We value: Customer problems over technical elegance. Shipping over endless planning. Simple solutions over unnecessary complexity. Ownership over handoffs. Iteration over perfection. Clear writing over excessive meetings. Pragmatic engineering over abstract architecture. AI where it helps us move faster. Measuring outcomes over assuming we were right. We care about high standards, but we do not confuse high standards with slow processes. We would rather ship a small useful improvement, learn from it, and improve it than spend months perfecting something before customers see it. At the same time, changes to Matomo Core can affect a large number of customers, integrations and plugins. You should be able to move pragmatically while recognising when additional investigation, testing or migration planning is necessary. What we’re looking for For senior: You're already operating with a high degree of autonomy. You naturally identify valuable opportunities, make pragmatic decisions in ambiguous situations, and multiply the team's impact through the systems you build, the decisions you influence and the way you approach problems. For intermediate: You're already comfortable delivering software independently and are looking to take greater ownership of customer problems, product decisions and technical direction. You enjoy building products You get motivated by solving customer problems and delivering value, not by technical novelty alone. You care whether people actually use and benefit from what you build. Seeing a feature make a real difference is more rewarding to you than building something technically clever that nobody uses. You naturally ask: What problem are we solving? Who has this problem? Is this the simplest useful solution? How will we know this made things better? What should we do if the data shows we were wrong? You are comfortable with complex, mature systems You do not need every problem to start with a clean architecture or an empty repository. You are comfortable tracing behaviour across an unfamiliar codebase, understanding historical constraints, debugging difficult interactions, and making incremental improvements without unnecessary rewrites. You can balance immediate customer needs with longer-term platform health. You know when to fix the immediate issue, when to address the underlying cause, and when a broader architectural change is justified. You are comfortable across the stack You are happy working wherever the problem takes you: frontend, backend, databases, APIs, product flows, documentation, or customer feedback. Our stack includes PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, Vue.js, and TypeScript. Exact stack experience is useful, but not required. We care more about your ability to learn, reason, ship, and solve meaningful problems. You use AI as part of how you work We make heavy use of AI-assisted development throughout our engineering workflow. You should already be using AI tools regularly or be strongly motivated to do so. We expect Product Engineers to use AI to increase output and quality. AI does not replace your judgment. You remain responsible for product decisions, technical correctness, security, privacy, maintainability, and customer impact. You’ll probably thrive here if You prefer owning outcomes over receiving detailed tickets. You enjoy solving difficult problems in existing systems as well as building new functionality. You can quickly diagnose complex or intermittent bugs. You can move from customer feedback or operational evidence to investigation, product decision and implementation. You care about reliability, performance and data accuracy, not only visible feature work. You can improve a mature codebase without assuming it needs to be rewritten. You use AI tools heavily and are actively improving how you work with them. You are pragmatic: you can make a focused improvement now while recognising when a deeper change is needed. You can explain technical and product trade-offs clearly. You enjoy working across product, engineering, UX, data and customer feedback. You like small teams where your decisions and output visibly matter. below for intermediate only: You're excited to take on increasingly ambiguous problems. You want to grow beyond implementation into shaping products and technical decisions. You may not enjoy this role if You mainly want to work on new greenfield products. You see maintenance, debugging, reliability or performance work as less valuable than feature development. You want a product manager to define most requirements before you start. You are uncomfortable investigating problems where the cause is initially unclear. You prefer replacing existing systems rather than understanding why they work as they do. You measure success mainly by code quality rather than user or business impact. You are uncomfortable using AI as part of your normal engineering workflow. You need a large team, narrow responsibilities, or highly formal processes to be effective. You prefer polishing a solution extensively before showing it to users. You dislike writing proposals, documentation, or product notes. You are uncomfortable balancing speed, backwards compatibility and long-term platform health. Remote work Matomo is a remote company. We work mostly asynchronously and rely heavily on clear written communication. You should be comfortable working independently, documenting your thinking, and collaborating without needing constant meetings. Location 100% remote — Germany, UK or Ireland only. Hiring process Our process is designed to understand how you think, build, communicate, and use AI in realistic product engineering work. The process usually includes: Application → Screening → Online aptitude test → People & Culture interview → Technical skills interview → Final technical interview. We do not expect unpaid multi-day projects. We want to understand how you approach ambiguous problems, make trade-offs, use AI, and ship useful product improvements. Diversity and Inclusion InnoCraft (trading as Matomo) values what makes you unique. We’re an inclusive employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, because diverse perspectives help us build better products. Interested? If you care about solving meaningful customer problems, improving software that people depend on, working with high ownership, and making privacy-friendly analytics more secure, reliable, accurate and useful, we’d like to hear from you. title: Engineering Manager - Experience Above the Box (all genders)
description: About tonies: tonies is the globally leading interactive audio platform for children with more than 10 million Tonieboxes and 125 million Tonies sold. The intuitive and award-winning audio system has changed the way young children play and learn independently with its child-safe, wireless, and screen-free approach. Tonieboxes have been activated in over 100 countries, the content portfolio includes around 1,400 Tonies in several languages. Since its inception, tonies has achieved significant milestones, including listing on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange in November 2021 as well as a globally present team of over 550 dedicated professionals operating from various countries. Joining our tonies team means being part of an inspiring mission to create innovative and meaningful experiences for children around the world. Together, we’re shaping the future of play, learning, and imagination. You as part of tonies: Above the box is where the magic of tonies becomes tangible: the Tonies themselves — Content, Creative, Clever — and Tonieplay. As Engineering Manager (all genders) for our Above-the-Box value stream, you lead a cross-functional team that owns these experiences end to end — from the device through App and cloud, across every Toniebox generation and every device our products will run on next. The team is newly formed and set to grow, with a mix of internal and external engineers. Together with your Product Manager, you shape both the experiences we ship and the team that builds them, bringing joy to millions of children worldwide. Ready to help us create the future of audio play? Your tasks and responsibilities will include: Team Leadership: You nurture the professional growth of your engineers and build a culture where inclusive mentorship, continuous learning, and high collaboration are the norm — across disciplines, and across internal and external team members alike. Building & Scaling the Team: You grow the team as our roadmap grows: shaping the profiles we hire, onboarding and integrating external engineers, and making sure critical knowledge stays with the team rather than walking out the door. End-to-End Ownership: You make your team genuinely accountable for its experiences — embedded, app, and cloud — rather than handing work over at team boundaries. Architectural Oversight: You oversee the structural integrity of the Above-the-Box implementations, ensuring a consistent user experience across multiple device generations through clean abstractions and cross-functional end-to-end ownership. Interfaces & Dependencies: You define the application-level APIs your team needs from our platform teams and turn cross-team dependencies into clear, testable contracts instead of coordination overhead. Product Sync & Strategy: You synchronise with Product Management to prioritise features and technical debt, ensuring that every engineering cycle directly fuels the overarching tonies® product vision. Leading Through Change: You bring the team through transitions with a clear vision, identifying what needs to improve and driving those improvements together with your engineers. Technical Credibility & Hands-on Depth: You stay close enough to the code to run high-impact reviews, challenge architectural decisions, and step in on critical problems — so our quality standards remain uncompromised, including for work delivered by external partners. Delivery Excellence: You manage the end-to-end delivery process, applying lean principles to streamline workflows and ensure stable, plannable, reliable releases for our customers. Your Team's Responsibilities Designing, building, and maintaining the Above-the-Box experience — our value stream covering everything our users experience beyond the box itself: Content-, Creative- and Clever Tonies Tonieplay Delivering these experiences across the full stack, from on-device software through app and cloud services Specifying the abstract interfaces (APIs) delivered by our lower-level platform teams, so the team can own its experiences end to end across hardware generations Safeguarding quality through end-to-end ownership and test automation owned inside the team Partnering closely with Product Management to translate the experience roadmap into sustainable delivery Acting as the point of contact for Above-the-Box topics across the wider engineering organisation What we are looking for: Leadership & Team Empowerment: You have experience leading engineering teams—including specialists outside your own discipline—and excel at turning complex challenges into a clear vision. You seamlessly integrate external engineers and partners to build one unified team grounded in shared standards, collective ownership, and zero second-class contributors. Technical Acumen & Hands-on Depth: You bring a long-standing background as a software engineer with genuine full-stack breadth — you have depth in embedded, backend, or mobile development , and enough working knowledge of the others to reason about, review, and challenge decisions across the whole stack. While your focus is on leadership and design, you can still dive into the codebase to unblock critical bottlenecks. Architectural Vision: You advocate for modular, flexibly extendable, loosely coupled architectures with strong cohesion — so a feature can be built once and shipped across several hardware generations without being rewritten each time. Strategic Product Alignment: You act as the bridge between engineering and product strategy. You translate business goals into technical reality and collaborate seamlessly across departments to keep our roadmap both ambitious and achievable. The Toolbox: Solid experience with software platforms and their architecture. Linux is your home ground, and Git, GitLab, and CI/CD are part of your daily workflow. Experience working with ODMs or hardware suppliers is a strong plus. Clean Design & Simplicity: You champion lean structures and have a knack for solving complex problems with simple, elegant solutions — in code and in organisational processes alike. Work Style: Your approach is defined by agility, empathy, and creativity, especially when exploring new solutions or navigating change. Communication & Collaboration: You communicate confidently in professional English (German is a plus) and enjoy being with your team in the office regularly. Last but not least: You are enthusiastic about our product and want to join us on our exciting journey! Why tonies? Global Teamwork: We collaborate across departmental and country borders on our vision to bring the Toniebox into every child's room in the world. Come as you are: This applies not only to the dress code but also to everything else. Because only where you truly feel comfortable can you give your best. Mobility : Choose the option that suits you best – a Deutschlandticket (public transport ticket) for unlimited mobility, a monthly contribution for an office parking space, a leasing bicycle, or a remote work subsidy. Enhanced Security: Benefit from subsidies for company pension plans, occupational pension schemes, and occupational disability insurance. Rest & Time Off: Enjoy 30 days of paid annual leave plus three additional days off such as Rosenmontag, Christmas Eve, and New Year's Eve. After one year of employment, you can also use up to 10 "toniecation days" (unpaid leave days). Continuous Learning : Benefit from our internal and external training opportunities as well as an individual learning budget to continuously expand your knowledge. Language Learning & Relaxation: Improve your communication skills with the language learning app Babbel and find relaxation through our access to the meditation app Calm. Discounts: Benefit from attractive discounts on our entire range of tonies products. Good to know: As part of our principles, we are committed to supporting inclusion and diversity at tonies. We actively celebrate our colleagues’ different abilities, ethnicities, faith and gender. Everyone is welcome and supported in their development at all stages in their journey with us. title: Software & Operations Engineer

title: Senior Analytics Engineer (Multiple Domains)
description: About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe. Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. Analytics at Wolt is a business-critical area that covers three different teams: data science, regional business operations, and analytics engineering. The complexity of online delivery, differences in the economics and dynamics of the cities we operate in, and vast amounts of data make our work truly interesting! Now we are looking for three experienced Senior Analytics Engineers to join our Analytics Engineering teams. We have three domains available: Consumer, Merchant, or Ads . You can work in Berlin, Stockholm or Helsinki . The role requires interpreting the needs and requests of our internal stakeholders from business and product, and transforming them into actionable data. Data Scientists working in the domain will be your closest partners in your day-to-day work, as your solutions will enable them to create relevant experiments, A/B tests, and analyses. Your daily work will include Developing reporting and metrics quality as a whole, from understanding the needs of the business to providing easily understandable and actionable data. Working on our centrally maintained data integrations and data pipelines powering our Data Warehouse, our data models, and dashboards. You'll get to utilize our modern tech stack as part of your work (Snowflake, SQL, Looker, Wolt Inhouse ETL, Airflow, Dagster, Github). Design and implement complex data pipelines with dependency control, orchestration, and auto-materialisation logic. Develop a self-service data modelling strategy and partner with Analytics and other stakeholders for implementation. Increase data literacy across the domain and expertise through hands-on training and documentation. Lead, mentor, and guide more junior team members. Our humble expectations 5+ years of experience working as an Analytics Engineer or BI Developer. Strong hands-on experience with data integrations, data pipelines, data models, metric development, and dashboards . Tech skills: Snowflake, SQL, Airflow, DBT, Looker, or other visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI, etc. Advanced SQL skills and ability to write optimized queries for large data sets. Strong business acumen and product-oriented thinking with significant experience in the design and implementation of analytics and reporting data models. What we offer The online delivery platform that Wolt is building will offer you interesting and complex challenges, together with the opportunities to create a big impact with your skills. Lots of geolocational and temporal data in real-time, combined with differences in the economics and dynamics of the cities we operate in, make Wolt both a challenging and interesting company to practice analytics. You can choose the location from our tech hubs in Berlin, Stockholm or Helsinki . You have the chance to decide the ways of working: a hybrid, at the office, or remote within the location above. 💙 You would get to work in a company culture where we take ownership beyond the obvious, do common things uncommonly well, we think big but stay humble, do right by people, we treat others kindly and justly, recognize that if we don't learn, we won't stay still but fall behind and keep in mind that Luke was Yoda's greatest achievement. title: Design Engineer
description: Mercura ( YC W25 ) helps the companies that build the real world move at software speed, automating the back-office work that runs the $12 trillion industry behind every hospital, school, and power plant. We started with one of their biggest bottlenecks - turning messy technical requests into accurate quotes - and eightfolded our revenue in 12 months . With a team of 16, we're now targeting $10M by the end of 2026 as well as our expansion into the US. About the role You are the second designer here, and you own product surface end to end: you find the problem, decide if it's worth solving, design it, build it, ship it, and then check whether it worked. That last part is the job. Most designers stop at handoff. You won't have one. You'll sit with a German construction supplier watching them fight a spreadsheet, decide which of their five complaints is the real one, and have something in front of them within days. Then you'll open PostHog to find out if it moved anything. We ship fast and polished. If those feel like you, this is the right role for you. What you will be working on Find the real problem. Run your own customer conversations — no PM filter. Distinguish what users ask for from what they need, and be willing to conclude something isn't worth building. Ship it yourself. Design and write the production code. React/TypeScript. You own the result, not a layer of it. Know if it worked. Instrument what you ship. Define the success metric before you build. Kill your own features when the data says so. Set the quality floor. Empty states, loading states, error states, keyboard behaviour, the transition that makes a slow thing feel fast. Nobody is going to catch these for you. Compress the loop. Prototype in whatever gets to a real answer fastest. Speed here means speed to validated user value, not speed to merged PR. What we're looking for Evidence of discovery. You've changed your own mind about what to build because of something a user said or did. You can tell us about a time you were wrong. Evidence of analytics. You've made a product decision from data you instrumented yourself. You know the difference between a metric that moved and a metric that mattered. Taste. You notice when spacing is off, when a flow doesn't communicate, when an interaction feels sluggish — and you fix it without being asked. We'll look at what you've made. Real code shipped to real users. React and TypeScript to production. Not prototypes, not a bootcamp project. Some Python helps; we can teach it. AI as leverage, not as identity. We don't care which tools you use. We care that you've restructured how you work around them and can show us the difference it made. German and English. Our users are almost entirely German-speaking. You'll be in those conversations from week one. How we work In the office, Munich, five days a week. We build in the same room — decisions happen at desks, not in tickets. Relocation support if you're not here yet. High pace, steep learning curve. Most of the team is here well past six. That's not a policy or a number we track, it's what building something this size with sixteen people currently takes, and it's a phase, not a permanent state. If you're optimising for predictable hours right now, this is the wrong role, and that's a completely reasonable thing to be optimising for. This is not the role if you want specs handed to you, you separate "my design work" from "my engineering work," you need a design system before you can start, or your best work needs a slide to explain it. About the Founders We are Lukas, Stefan & Sean , the co-founders of Mercura. We share a deep commitment to excellence and the discipline to pursue what others might consider impossible. Two of us come from non-academic families, and we all know what it means to create our own paths and overcome barriers. This experience shapes our belief in equal opportunity and fuels our dedication to social mobility. Lukas (left) is responsible for business development at Mercura. With his background as a Data Scientist at Allianz and at Google in Silicon Valley, he brings extensive expertise in data and AI. Lukas’ family has been active in the construction industry for over 100 years, giving him a deep understanding and passion for the sector's specific needs. Sean (middle) is responsible for technical development at Mercura. As a top 0.01% physicist, Sean earned a Silver medal for Germany at the International Physics Olympiad (IPhO), began researching with the Max Planck Institute at the age of 16, and has since published at leading machine learning conferences. Stefan (right) leads product development at Mercura. Previously, he worked in management consulting at Bain & Company, where he helped manufacturers improve their operations. Stefan leverages his research experience at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) and Harvard Business School to develop innovative solutions for the industry. At Mercura, we believe that the best ideas emerge when people from different backgrounds collaborate together. We hire based on ability, mindset, and values, and we live by one simple rule: the best idea wins. Beyond Mercura, we actively support initiatives that promote diversity and gender equity and commit a portion of our personal income each year to organizations expanding opportunity for others. title: Senior SW Engineer – Embedded Linux SDK & Distribution (M/W/D)
description: Mobileye is looking for a passionate Systems Software Developer to join the Operating System Team in the EyeQ Platform Software Group. While many work on Linux, we work in Linux. We are looking for an experienced systems engineer to join our Core Distribution team . The center of this role is the Linux userspace and the distribution itself: boot and service bring-up, root filesystem composition, and the integration of external SDK into that platform. You will also build Python-based deployment tooling so the OS and SDK stack can be provisioned reproducibly - infrastructure and tool development in service of the OS. Debug at the OS boundary - init/service failures, library and ABI mismatches, missing dependencies, and SDK/runtime issues on the target. Perform root cause analysis on system-level failures in the distribution, from boot and userspace bring-up through a fully operational stack. Collaborate on board bring-up, tailoring the distribution and SDK integration to new EyeQ generations and related target hardware. Deep knowledge of Linux Internals, specifically the boot process (Bootloaders, Kernel hand-off, Init systems) and root filesystem layout. Hands-on experience with Embedded Linux Distributions (e.g., custom Yocto recipes, Buildroot, or Linux-from-scratch).
