title: Systems Engineer, MCP Portals
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Lisbon, Portugal </strong></p> <h2>Role Summary</h2> <p>Cloudflare MCP Server Portals give organizations a secure, centralized way to connect AI agents to internal and third-party tools. As a Systems Engineer on the MCP Portals team, you will build and operate the distributed systems that authenticate users, manage OAuth credentials and sessions, enforce Zero Trust policies, and proxy MCP traffic across Cloudflare's global network. You will own scoped projects from design through rollout and production support, working with engineers and product managers across Access, Gateway, and Developer Platform teams. We are looking for an engineer who can make sound technical decisions, work through ambiguous systems problems, and take responsibility for the services they build.</p> <h2>Role Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Design, implement, and operate distributed services that connect MCP clients to authorized upstream MCP servers.</li> <li>Own scoped features and service improvements through design, implementation, testing, rollout, observability, and production follow-up.</li> <li>Evolve our implementation as the MCP specification changes while maintaining compatibility for existing customers and integrations.</li> <li>Build secure authentication and authorization flows involving Cloudflare Access, OAuth, identity, and delegated access to upstream services.</li> <li>Improve the reliability, scalability, latency, and resource efficiency of multi-tenant systems built on the Cloudflare Developer Platform.</li> <li>Use structured logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, and alerts to understand service behavior; participate in production support and incident response.</li> <li>Investigate customer issues across multiple services, distinguishing product defects from upstream failures, policy configuration, and infrastructure dependencies.</li> <li>Collaborate with product, security, and engineering partners to turn customer needs and emerging standards into maintainable product capabilities.</li> </ul> <h2>Role Requirements</h2> <h3>Must Have Skills</h3> <ul> <li>4+ years of experience building and operating distributed systems, backend services, network services, or infrastructure products in production.</li> <li>Strong programming skills in TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, Rust, C++, or another language used to build production services.</li> <li>Experience independently delivering changes to a production service, including testing, deployment, monitoring, and follow-up.</li> <li>A solid understanding of HTTP, APIs, proxies, streaming connections, and common distributed-systems failure modes.</li> <li>Experience debugging production systems using logs, metrics, traces, error reporting, and customer-provided evidence.</li> <li>Ability to reason carefully about security boundaries, credential handling, concurrency, state management, and backward-compatible deployments.</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical tradeoffs and coordinate work across team boundaries.</li> </ul> <p>Applicants should provide a resume or CV describing relevant engineering and operational experience.</p> <h3>Nice to Have Skills</h3> <ul> <li>Experience with authentication and authorization technologies such as OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWTs, PKCE, or policy-based access control.</li> <li>Experience with the Model Context Protocol</li> <li>Familiarity with the Cloudflare Developer Platform or other serverless edge-computing platforms.</li> <li>Experience building gateways, forward proxies, identity systems, developer platforms, or Zero Trust and data loss prevention products.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of €45,000-62,000 </span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Validation: </strong>Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. . Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.</li> <li><strong>Customer Adoption & Value Realization: </strong>Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer’s environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance), and act as the lead consultant for customer engineering teams, walking them step-by-step through configuration best practices.  Partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes. </li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: </strong>Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> <li><strong>Education & Enablement:</strong> Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience: Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services,  Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience required will vary based on Associate, Senior, Staff, or Principal leveling).</li> <li>Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly.</li> <li>Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.</li> <li>Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.</li> <li>Technical Breadth: We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every domain. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below:</li> <ul> <li>Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.</li> <li>Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.</li> <li>Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.</li> <li>AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.</li> <li>Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> <li>Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")</strong></p> <ul> <li>Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms. </li> <li>Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls.</li> <li>Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.</li> <li>Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Education</strong></p> <p>Undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. </p> <p><strong>Travel</strong></p> <p>This role may require travel up to 20–50% to attend customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and in-person team collaboration.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  </p></div><p><strong>What to expect</strong></p> <p>The Platform Engineering team builds, secures and operates scalable infrastructure supporting cloud-managed SaaS products with on-premises components deployed at customer sites.</p> <p>As our Staff DevSecOps Engineer, you will provide the technical leadership for our software factory, defining how software is built, secured and released across the organisation. title: Senior Quality Manager
description: About the role Imagine owning the quality backbone of an aerospace company moving at full speed. While innovation accelerates around you, you ensure every design and every process meets the highest standards without slowing the momentum. As the Engineering Quality Manager, you will ensure that our engineering Organisation (including the Design Organization (DO)) maintains compliance with applicable standards and best practices (like EASA Part 21 Subpart J, EN9100). You’ll lead the development and oversight of our quality system, manage design supplier qualification and monitoring, drive internal and external audits and continuous improvement across all design, qualification and certification activities. At Destinus , we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations. What You´ll Do Be responsible for establishing, documenting, developing and managing the Quality System and for ensuring that it continues to comply with regulatory requirements and business needs. Support and guide our Engineering departments in the definition and implementation of efficient processes. Oversee design supplier qualification, categorization, and ongoing performance monitoring. Maintain and enhance the quality system, including document control, change management, and compliance monitoring Monitor compliance of internal processes with established industry standards and certification authority requirements (such as EN9100, EASA Part 21J and required military standards). Plan, conduct, and document internal and external audits in line with established processes. Track and follow up on audit findings and corrective actions. Collaborate with stakeholders and external auditors (e.g., EASA, MoD), and cross-functional teams to ensure compliance and quality standards are met. Requirements What You’ll Need 7+ years in military or civil aviation or aerospace quality and compliance, or other highly quality driven industries such as automotive, energy with hands-on experience in the aviation industry Experience with supplier quality management. Track record in leading quality investigations, undertaking root cause analysis, developing corrective action plans, and ensuring the effectiveness of actions undertaken. Audit training/certification or experience setting up ISO 9001, AS9100, AQAP2110 quality systems required. Familiarity with EASA Part 21 Subpart J and industry certification standards (e.g., DO-178C, DO-254, STANAGs). Strong communication, analytical, and cross-functional collaboration skills Who You Are You are naturally detail obsessed but never lose sight of the bigger picture. You combine regulatory sharpness with practical engineering judgment and you know when to challenge and when to enable. Calm under pressure, you bring structure to complexity and clarity to ambiguity. You are assertive without ego, collaborative without compromising standards. When something is not compliant, you speak up. When a process can be better, you improve it. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

Ability to translate complex technical concepts for both technical and executive audience</li> <li>Regional Experience — Experience working with enterprise customers in APJC. Understanding of regional compliance requirements, business culture, and technical ecosystems.</li> </ul> <h3>Preferred Qualifications</h3> <ul> <li>Experience in heavily regulated industries (Public Sector, Financial Services, Healthcare) or complex legacy-migration environments.</li> <li>Relevant industry certifications: CISSP, CCIE, AWS, GCP, Azure certifications, or equivalent.</li> <li>Familiarity with Agile methodologies and enterprise change-management processes.</li> <li>Familiarity with Zero Trust / SASE — Securing distributed workforces with Access, Gateway, CASB, RBI, and DLP. Fresha’s ecosystem gives merchants everything they need to run their business seamlessly by facilitating appointment bookings, point-of-sale, customer records management, marketing automation, loyalty, beauty products inventory and team management. The consumer marketplace unlocks revenue potential for partner businesses by leveraging the power of online bookings and automated marketing through mobile apps and advanced integrations with major tech brands including Instagram, Facebook and Google. Reporting directly to the Account Manager Team Lead, you will be accountable for building relationships and driving monetisation of the Fresha platform. This is a great opportunity for someone looking to work in a fast-paced and changing environment, who likes to work autonomously, enjoys a challenge, and wants to make an impact. To foster a collaborative environment that thrives on face-to-face interactions and teamwork, all Fresha employees work from office five days per week in Paris, on the Champs-élysées. Commercial Growth Engagement - Accountable for meeting key performance indicators on monetisation and revenue growth by proactively engaging with and educating our Partners on the value of the Fresha platform. Sales Cycle - Proactively introduce, educate and convert Partners on to Fresha’s payments solution. Market Trends - Optimise listing content and availability competitiveness on the marketplace to maximise conversions. Relationship Building Partnering - Have a pool of Partner accounts serving as a dedicated advisor for all your Partners assisting them on their journey to product adoption. Advisor - Advising Partners on suitable product selection based on their needs and specifications. Business Partnering - Ensure a strong Partner Experience through building relationships by attending video meetings with your pool of Partners and effectively communicating the Fresha features and benefits. Relationships - Build key internal relationships with our Sales and Onboarding teams to ensure smooth transition and handover of Partners through the Partner journey. Collaboration - Collaborate with our Product teams to provide important product feedback to help enhance future releases. Interview Process Screen Call - Video-call with a member from the Talent Team (30 mins) Skills & Experience - In-Person interview with Team Leads (30 mins) Presentation - In-Person interview with General Manager. title: Robotics Software Engineer - Grasping
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Intrinsic is an AI robotics group at Google aiming to reimagine the potential of industrial robotics. Our team believes that advances in AI, perception and simulation will redefine what’s possible for industrial robotics in the near future – with software and data at the core.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Our mission is to make industrial robotics intelligent, accessible, and usable for millions more businesses, entrepreneurs, and developers. We are a dynamic team of engineers, roboticists, designers, and technologists who are passionate about unlocking the creative and economic potential of industrial robotics.</span></p></div><h2>Role</h2> <p>As a Robotics Software Engineer, you will develop and implement robust algorithms to facilitate complex robotic operations in real-world manufacturing environments. Our team is responsible for both motion planning and grasping, with this role dedicated specifically to advancing our grasping capabilities. To succeed, you will bring a strong foundation in robotics—whether from a background in motion planning, control systems, or manipulation—to write excellent, production-quality code. You will help abstract the inherent complexity of robotic tasks into intuitive, seamless workflows, enabling users to transition from design to execution without needing deep subject matter expertise. Working alongside a diverse team of roboticists and application engineers, you will integrate and validate solutions across various industrial tasks and contribute to the launch of impactful robotics products.</p> <h2>How your work moves the mission forward</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Algorithm Development:</strong> Design, implement, and maintain efficient, production-ready algorithms for robotic grasping.</li> <li><strong>Problem Solving:</strong> Collaborate with the team to apply cutting-edge advancements in robotics to practical, real-world industrial problems.</li> <li><strong>Technical Execution:</strong> Transform complex partner requirements into highly reliable, functional, and scalable technical outcomes.</li> <li><strong>System Reliability:</strong> Improve our core robotics software framework, ensuring high code quality and contributing to a highly reliable product.</li> </ul> <h2>Skills you will need to be successful</h2> <ul> <li>Master’s degree in Robotics, Computer Science, or a related field.</li> <li>2+ years of professional experience in robotics (backgrounds in motion planning, control, or grasping/manipulation are all welcome).</li> <li><strong>Software Engineering:</strong> Exceptional programming skills in C++ and Python, with a proven track record of writing clean, efficient, and production-quality software.</li> <li><strong>Robotics Fundamentals:</strong> Strong foundation in linear algebra, spatial transformations, kinematics, and rigid body dynamics.</li> <li><strong>Hardware Experience:</strong> Direct experience testing, deploying, and iterating on physical robot hardware.</li> </ul> <h2>Skills that will differentiate your candidacy</h2> <ul> <li>PhD in Robotics or a related field with a specific focus on motion description: <div class="content-intro"><p></p> <div data-ogsc="black"><span data-ogsc="" data-ogsb="yellow"><strong data-ogsc="" data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">About Acadia Pharmaceuticals</strong></span></div> <div data-ogsc="black"> </div> <div data-ogsc="black"><span data-ogsc="" data-ogsb="yellow">Acadia is committed to turning scientific promise into meaningful innovation that makes the difference for underserved neurological and rare disease communities around the world. Our commercial portfolio includes the first and only FDA-approved treatments for Parkinson’s disease psychosis and Rett syndrome. We are developing the next wave of therapeutic advancements with a robust and diverse pipeline that includes mid- to late-stage programs in Alzheimer’s disease psychosis and Lewy body dementia psychosis, along with earlier-stage programs that address other underserved patient needs. At Acadia, we’re here to be their difference.</span></div></div><p><strong><u>Position Summary</u></strong></p> <p>The Associate Director, Regulatory Affairs Europe is responsible for the implementation and execution of global regulatory development, submission and lifecycle maintenance strategies for assigned products in Europe. Staying abreast of the ever evolving regulatory and therapeutic landscapes, the Associate Director will inform regional and global strategic plans on a continuous basis. Further, the Associate Director will assist in building a European regulatory infrastructure that is fit for purpose in line with Acadia’s product pipeline, patient and caregiver needs and in full compliance with European regulatory requirements and standards.</p> <p><strong><u>Primary Responsibilities</u></strong></p> <ul> <li>Proactively initiate, manage, submit and maintain regulatory activities in support of the development, commercialization and maintenance of assigned products in compliance with reporting requirements.</li> <li>Plan, coordinate and manage Pediatric Investigation Plans and Orphan Designations.</li> <li>Responsible for the planning, coordination, authoring and finalisation of major regulatory components of Marketing and Extension Applications, Renewals and Variations</li> <li>Plan and coordinate heath authority meetings including the preparation and authoring of major components of briefing documentation in close collaboration with cross-functional teams.</li> <li>Develop regulatory strategy for assigned products in line with the global regulatory strategy ensuring competitive labeling and approval timelines in Europe (through centralised, decentralised or national procedures).</li> <li>Lead the European Regulatory Subteam during major submissions.</li> <li>Monitor, evaluate, and interpret applicable regulatory requirements to assure compliance with external and internal standards.</li> <li>Support early access/ compassionate use programs in Europe.</li> <li>Execute team, group, or project objectives to ensure they align with Regulatory strategy and corporate goals.</li> <li>Maintain appropriate communication within the Regulatory Affairs function and other cross-functional departments primarily at the project team level.</li> <li>Participates in professional associations, industry, and trade groups to keep current on regulatory developments, applying knowledge to assigned programs.</li> <li>Works with growing independence under the direction of supervisor.</li> <li>Other duties as assigned.</li> </ul> <p><strong><u>Education/Experience/Skills</u></strong></p> <p>B.S. or M.S. with 7 years of relevant drug development experience, including 5 years relevant regulatory affairs experience in the EU. Ph.D., Pharm. D., or M.D. with 5 years relevant drug development including 3 years regulatory affairs experience in the EU.</p> <p>Key Skills:</p> <ul> <li>Proven track record of successfully leading major submission components (e.g. Module 1 of a MAA) in Europe.</li> <li>Effective regulatory project management (preparation, coordination, submission and maintenance of regulatory applications).</li> <li>Ability to coordinate deliverables using effective time management across multiple projects in a cross-geographic and cross-functional matrix team environment.</li> <li>Ability to think critically, strategically, independently and solve problems, include the ability to innovate.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills, demonstrative strong presentation skills.</li> <li>Strong interpersonal and teamwork skills.</li> <li>Strong regulatory/ scientific writing skills.</li> <li>Strong interest to stay abreast of scientific and regulatory standards and procedures.</li> <li>High level of motivation, drive, and demonstration of Acadia values.</li> <li>Must be willing an able to travel both domestically and internationally as needed.</li> </ul> title: Staff Security Engineer, Incident Response
description: <p>RDQ327R180</p> <p><strong>Staff Security Engineer, Incident Response</strong></p> <p>The Incident Response team's mission is to respond to security threats, incidents and investigations to protect our customers, employees and enterprise data in a fast, efficient and standardised manner. We're a tight-knit team of security incident responders and incident handlers doing "Security for Databricks on Databricks", using our own platform to create near-real-time log analytics, alerting and forensics.</p> <p>You will be an individual contributor on the security Incident Response (IR) team at Databricks, reporting to the regional IR manager. You will be responsible for conducting security analysis and forensics, responding to high-priority alerts and contributing to automations and agentic capabilities. You will be a security multiplier and help the team scale security incident response at Databricks.</p> <p><strong>The impact you will have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You will respond to incidents as part of a distributed 24x7 operations and on-call schedule.</li> <li>You will triage and respond to security events and alerts, ensuring quick and effective containment.</li> <li>You will conduct analysis and forensics across a range of data sources to determine the timeline and impact of security events.</li> <li>You will provide technical leadership and influence team direction.</li> <li>You will develop solutions, including leveraging AI and agentic platforms, to deliver autonomous capabilities, expedite your work and scale the impact of the team.</li> <li>You will communicate technical decisions through design docs and tech talks, and mentor junior security responders via security guidance, design reviews and code reviews.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we look for:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's Degree AND 7+ years experience in Incident Response work OR Master's Degree AND 5+ years experience.</li> <li>Cloud security expertise in at least 1 of AWS, GCP or Azure, and proficiency in the others.</li> <li>Proficiency in AI/LLM and agentic capabilities. Prefer experience with building and operating agentic systems in a security setting.</li> <li>Broad security subject matter expertise.</li> <li>Expertise in a few core IR skills (DFIR , Reverse Engineering, Traditional Network Security, Storage and access security, Sandboxing, Compute security, etc.).</li> <li>Experience with Enterprise Security and SaaS applications.</li> <li>Working knowledge of a SIEM and SOAR.</li> <li>Experience building Incident Response Tooling, scripting language skills and experience with AI coding tools.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About Databricks</strong></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, sans-serif;">Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. title: Technical Support Engineer, Zero Trust
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Location: Singapore</strong></h3> <h3><strong>About the Team</strong></h3> <p>The Cloudflare Customer Support Team solves complicated problems and answers technical questions via phone, email, chat and social media. Whether it is a Wordpress blogger using our services for free or a global Enterprise business with petabytes of web traffic, we are always eager to assist. We are the eyes and ears of Cloudflare, acting as the real-time voice of the customer to help communicate their needs and real-world use cases back to the rest of the company - for better service and future product development.</p> <h3><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h3> <p>Do you love solving complex technical issues and interacting with people? Are you passionate about providing premium-level support to customers and are a standout colleague? Cloudflare is seeking an experienced <strong>Technical </strong><strong>Support Engineer</strong><strong> for Zero Trust </strong>to join our team. You will work with our largest and most technically sophisticated customers on a variety of technical support issues to ensure they can deploy and operate Cloudflare's Zero Trust solutions with confidence. </p> <ul> <li>Serve as a trusted technical advisor, providing advanced support for enterprise customers using Cloudflare’s Zero Trust platform, including products like Access, Gateway, and Teams.</li> <li>Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues related to identity, device security, and secure application access.</li> <li>Work directly with customers to diagnose and remediate configuration and integration challenges with authentication protocols (e.g., SSO, SAML, OIDC) and network security settings.</li> <li>Create and maintain knowledge base articles, technical guides, and troubleshooting documentation for internal and customer use.</li> <li>Partner with Cloudflare’s Product, Engineering, and Security teams to escalate and resolve advanced customer issues.</li> <li>Provide feedback based on customer interactions to drive product improvements and ensure alignment with user needs.</li> <li>Assist customers in identifying and responding to security incidents, leveraging Cloudflare’s threat intelligence and security tools.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What We're Looking For</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You have a minimum of 4 years experience working as a Support Engineer / Sr. Support Engineer supporting networking or web security products.</li> <li>Exceptional troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts for customers.</li> <li>Strong customer service orientation and communication skills, both written and verbal.</li> <li>Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.</li> <li>You have experience supporting and troubleshooting multi-factor mechanisms (TOTP, SMS, FIDO, U2F, WebAuth, EMAIL, Push MFA, etc).</li> <li>Hands-on experience with identity and access management (IAM) systems, such as Okta, Ping Identity, or Azure Active Directory.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of authentication protocols (SAML, OIDC, LDAP) and secure web gateway technologies.</li> <li>Proficiency in networking fundamentals, including DNS, VPNs, firewalls, and traffic routing.</li> <li>Experience supporting cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and SaaS application integrations.</li> <li>You have worked with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MS SQL or other database servers.</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field (or equivalent experience).</li> <li>Relevant certifications such as Cloudflare Certified Zero Trust Specialist, CISSP, or CCSP.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Infrastructure & Security Lead
description: About Luo Luo is one of the fastest-growing FX and cross-border payments companies in Africa. We help African businesses pay their international suppliers faster, more transparently, and more competitively than traditional solutions. After becoming a leading player in a few markets in record time, we are looking to grow our engineering team and keep expanding the financial infrastructure for FX and cross-border payments in Africa. Role overview As Infrastructure & Security Lead, you will join a small team of experienced engineers and be responsible for evolving our cloud infrastructure and its security controls. You will work directly with our CTO to build the foundations that keep LuoPay secure, reliable, and compliant as we scale. The scope covers our GCP infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, security tooling, as well as the security and compliance program that regulators, partners, and customers depend on. Key responsibilities Analyze our infrastructure and map security risks. Write clear, concise design documents to share infrastructure targets with the rest of the engineering team. Use Terraform to evolve our GCP infrastructure. Use GCP-native security tooling to protect our network, services and databases within GCP. Automate security testing within our delivery pipelines. Research and onboard new tools to improve our reliability and security posture. Work alongside our CTO to implement our security and compliance framework. What we are looking for 10+ years of tech engineering experience Strong experience building cloud infrastructure, managing cloud security and writing Terraform code. Experience within GCP is highly appreciated, though we value fundamental engineering skills over any knowledge of a specific tech stack. Strong appetite for security focused technical work. Wide technical curiosity and willingness to contribute to many different parts of our stack: IAM, networking, governance, CI/CD, observability, APIs and web security. Previous experience working in small, fast-paced teams. Previous experience building cloud infrastructure within a regulated industry is appreciated. Previous experience participating in the implementation of ISO27001 or SOC2 compliance is appreciated. Why join us Play a key role in building the fintech infrastructure that unlocks international payments for businesses in Africa. Work alongside a small team of senior engineers within a fast-paced, growing startup. Be exposed to an an usual breadth of technical responsibilities, with room to grow. Be given the room and support to build a state-of-the art security program in a regulated industry. Continuously experiment with LLMs to expand the boundaries of your impact. title: Junior Product Owner
description: Your journey ROMEO is the queer company behind the legendary ROMEO dating app, one of Europe’s longest-standing dating platforms for queer communities. We are looking for a Product Owner to join our Product team in Berlin and help shape how ideas and product requirements make their way into the hands of millions of users. In this delivery-focused role, you will work closely with Product Management, Design, Engineering, QA and BI to turn product priorities into clear, actionable work for our development teams. It is a great opportunity to grow your product skills while taking real ownership of the day-to-day delivery process. Your typical day Support the Product Management team in refining product requirements and translating approved PRDs into implementation-ready epics, user stories and tickets. Ensure user stories have clear acceptance criteria and are sufficiently refined before entering development. Maintain and order the backlog according to priorities set by product leadership. Take part in regular and ad hoc meetings to clarify product requirements with development, design and other delivery teams. Support our two-week delivery cycle by ensuring development teams have the information and decisions they need to proceed. Identify missing requirements, dependencies, open decisions and blockers early, and escalate them to Product or Delivery. Work closely with QA to communicate product and release priorities, clarify acceptance criteria, and support defect triage and release-readiness decisions. Support product acceptance and release readiness by checking delivered functionality against agreed requirements and acceptance criteria. Support the BI team by translating product questions, KPIs and tracking needs into clear data requirements. Ensure agreed analytics requirements are captured as part of delivery, including relevant event tracking before work is considered complete. Maintain clear and up-to-date product documentation in Jira and Confluence. We look for You are passionate about building products for LGBTQ+ communities and interested in contributing to the continued development of ROMEO. You have initial experience in a Product Owner or similar product delivery role, ideally in a B2C environment. Experience in social, dating or community products is a plus. Being familiar with how our product works is a plus. You have experience writing or refining user stories and acceptance criteria. You have a good understanding of Agile product development and ideally hands-on experience with Scrum and/or Kanban. You are comfortable working with Jira and Confluence. Experience with Xray is a plus. You are organised, detail-oriented and reliable in following work through to completion. You proactively follow up on missing information and drive requirements towards clarity. You are based in Berlin or willing to relocate and are happy to work from our Wittenbergplatz office at least three days per week. You have excellent written and spoken English skills, ideally at a native or near-native level. What We Offer A hands-on role working on an established European digital product during a significant phase of product and technology transformation. Close collaboration with Product, Design, Engineering, QA and BI, Hybrid working (3 days per week in our Berlin office at Wittenbergplatz) €40 employer contribution towards the Germany Job Ticket EGYM Wellpass (only €20/month employee contribution) In-house German classes Annual learning budget (e.g. for conferences, courses, certifications) International team, English-speaking environment Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange™️ platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 160+ public exchanges globally and thousands of private exchanges at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.</p> <p>We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.</p></div><p><strong>Role</strong> </p> <p>We are looking for an Account Executive to join our team. This is a Hybrid role, reporting to the Regional Sales Director in the Sales and Go-to-Market department. The Sales and Go-to-Market team is a global group of professionals dedicated to delighting customers and driving a secure, cloud-enabled digital future by demonstrating the power and agility of cloud transformation to the world and cementing Zscaler’s position as a global leader.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do (Role Expectations)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage an assigned strategic territory in Switzerland focused on net new logo acquisition and upsell opportunities in the Romandy</li> <li>Build relationships with key stakeholders, including C-Level decision-makers</li> <li>Create long-term account strategies aligned with customer goals</li> <li>Collaborate with internal teams to meet customer needs and contribute to account planning</li> <li>Act as a trusted advisor by understanding client businesses and aligning Zscaler solutions with their goals</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who You Are (Success Profile)</strong></p> <ul> <li>You thrive in ambiguity. You are comfortable building the path as you walk it, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.</li> <li>You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action, operating with integrity and navigating seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.</li> <li>You are a problem-solver. You seek out challenges because you are laser-focused on finding solutions that deliver maximum impact.</li> <li>You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, embracing a challenge culture with candid feedback delivered with clarity and respect.</li> <li>You are a learner. You have a growth mindset, actively seeking feedback to continuously develop as a partner and teammate.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving</li> <li>7+ years of full-cycle sales experience within the software or security industry</li> <li>Established relationships with current and prospective customers</li> <li>Progressive selling experience engaging with accounts and selling at the C-Level</li> <li>Business fluency in French</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Deep understanding of customer goals and how technology facilitates business outcomes</li> <li>Proficiency in strategic sales planning with a proven track record of closing net new logos</li> </ul> <p>#LI-MM5 #LI-HYBRID</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p data-pm-slice="1 3 []">At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure.</p> <p>Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including:</p> <div class="has-nudge" data-nudge-id="5eb9419b-6a4d-4451-bfa6-e2eb96084be0"> <ul> <li>Various health plans</li> <li>Time off plans for vacation and sick time</li> <li>Parental leave options</li> <li>Retirement options</li> <li>Education reimbursement</li> <li>In-office perks, and more!</li> </ul> <div class="has-nudge" data-nudge-id="5eb9419b-6a4d-4451-bfa6-e2eb96084be0"> <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">Learn more about Zscaler's hybrid working model and benefits <a href="https://www.zscaler.com/candidate-resource-hub" target="_blank">here</a>.</p> </div> </div> <p>By applying for this role, you adhere to applicable laws, regulations, and Zscaler policies, including those related to security and privacy standards and guidelines.</p> <p class="p1">Zscaler is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals. We strive to create a workplace where employees are treated with respect and have the chance to succeed. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy or related medical conditions), age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. <em>See more information by clicking on the </em><a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/sites/default/files/2023-06/22-088_EEOC_KnowYourRights6.12ScreenRdr.pdf"><em>Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal </em></a><em>link.</em></p> <p>Pay Transparency</p> <p>Zscaler complies with all applicable federal, state, and local pay transparency rules.</p> <p>Zscaler is committed to providing reasonable support (called accommodations or adjustments) in our recruiting processes for candidates who are differently abled, have long term conditions, mental health conditions or sincerely held religious beliefs, or who are neurodivergent or require pregnancy-related support.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Customer Support Coach
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>What Makes Cloudbeds Unique</strong><br>At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our intelligently designed platform powers properties across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From independent properties to hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've become the World's Best Hotel PMS Solutions Provider and landed on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again in 2024, but we're just getting started. </p></div><p><strong><span style="color: rgb(38, 28, 10);">How You'll Make an Impact: </span></strong></p> <p>As a Customer Support Coach, you will be the voice of and advocate for our customers, providing exceptional support. By resolving questions and troubleshooting issues across multiple channels, you’ll ensure a seamless experience for our hotel partners. Your contributions will strengthen client relationships, promote software adoption, and shape the future of our platform by sharing valuable feedback. You'll also play a key role in creating training materials, updating support resources, and staying ahead of system updates, making a lasting impact on our customers and team.</p> <p><span style="color: rgb(38, 28, 10);"><strong>Our Customer Support Team:</strong></span></p> <p>Join a dynamic, fully remote team of over 60 global Customer Support professionals united by our goal of delivering exceptional customer experiences across live chat, email, and phone. We pride ourselves on our supportive, diverse, and collaborative culture, where continuous learning, growth, and innovation drive everything we do. Be part of a team that values connection, celebrates success, and always strives to exceed expectations!</p> <p><strong><span style="color: rgb(38, 28, 10);">What You Bring to the Team:</span></strong></p> <ul> <li>Assist and support our existing customers (hotel properties) daily in the use of our software</li> <li>Resolve customers' inquiries via phone, email, chat, or any other media that Cloudbeds uses to help customers</li> <li>Troubleshoot and make outbound calls for escalated issues</li> <li>Foster strong customer relationships with empathy to drive loyalty, retention, and increased software adoption.</li> <li>Gather customers' feedback and requirements for future releases of the software</li> <li>Use training materials and attend company-wide online training sessions to keep up-to-date with the latest system updates</li> </ul> <p><span style="color: rgb(38, 28, 10);"><strong>What Sets You Up for Success: </strong></span></p> <ul> <li>1+ years of <strong>hands-on, front-of-house hospitality operations experience at a hotel or resort</strong> — Front Desk, Night Auditor, Guest Services, Revenue Manager, Assistant Manager, or similar role at a quality property. (Airline, event, or food & beverage-only experience does not meet this requirement.)</li> <li>Previous experience in customer service or similar is a plus</li> <li>Native or Fluent in English</li> <li>Native or Fluent in Spanish/Portuguese/French/German</li> <li>Excellent communication skills and a positive attitude</li> <li>Excellent problem-solving skills and emotional intelligence</li> <li>Great levels of learning agility</li> <li>A compatible graduation course or more than 2 years of proven experience in the area</li> <li>Skill with computers and systems</li> <li>Excellent internet/wifi connection</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>What to Expect - Your Journey with Us</strong><br>Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team of redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ employees across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle. Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in tech who are obsessed with using AI to transform a trillion-dollar industry, this is your chance to be part of something extraordinary.</p> <p>Learn more online at <a href="https://www.cloudbeds.com/">cloudbeds.com</a> </p> <p><strong>Company <a href="https://www.cloudbeds.com/press/?press_type=company-news&news_category=awards">Awards</a>:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Best All-In-One Hotel Management System | HotelTechAwards (2025)</li> <li>Overall 10 Best Places to Work | HotelTechAwards (2025)</li> <li>Most Loved Workplace® Certified (2024)</li> <li>Top 10 People’s Choice (2024)</li> <li>Deloitte Technology Fast 500 (2024)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Discover our Benefits:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Remote First, Remote Always</li> <li>PTO in accordance with local labor requirements</li> <li>Fully Paid Parental Leave</li> <li>Home office stipend based on country of residency</li> <li>Professional development courses in Cloudbeds University</li> <li>Access to professional development, including manager training, upskilling and knowledge transfer </li> </ul> <p><strong>Everyone is Welcome - A Culture of Inclusion </strong> </p> <p>Cloudbeds is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer that celebrates the diversity in our global team! We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.</p> <p>Cloudbeds is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Cloudbeds will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations in the hiring process. We encourage deaf, hard-of-hearing, deaf-blind, and deaf-disabled individuals to apply. title: Software Engineer, Platform - Zurich, Switzerland
description: <p>The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.</p> <p>Over 50 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.  </p> <p>Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. </p> <p><strong>Overview</strong></p> <p style="text-align: left;" data-speechify-sentence="">The Platform team owns the backend behind everything Speechify ships: the public TTS API, payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and analytics — serving over 50 million users across iOS, Android, Mac, Chrome, and web.</p> <p style="text-align: left;" data-speechify-sentence="">These are systems where correctness compounds. Subscription state has to stay consistent across five clients and two app-store billing systems that each go quiet at the worst moment. Consumption metering has to be exact enough to bill on and cheap enough to run at our request volume. The public TTS API has external customers with their own products depending on our latency and uptime. None of this degrades gracefully — it is either right, or someone gets charged twice.</p> <p data-speechify-sentence="">The job is to make your own job smaller. Every system you own here should need less of you a year from now than it did the day you took it, and the reward for that is a larger one. That is the entire growth path on this team — there is no separate ladder, and no ceiling except the one you stop raising. working knowledge of AWS, Azure, or another cloud</li> <li>A habit of giving away work you used to own, and something to show for the room it created</li> <li>A daily working setup with AI agents you can describe in detail — what runs unattended, what you review, and where you've decided it doesn't get to act alone</li> <li>The instinct to check a result against the system itself — logs, database state, the actual request — rather than against a summary of it</li> <li>Judgment about what not to build, and the ability to say plainly why you dropped it</li> <li>A preference for being corrected over being right</li> <li>Preferred: Docker and containerized deployments</li> <li>Preferred: deploying high-availability applications on Kubernetes</li> </ul> <p><strong>Interview process</strong></p> <p>Several technical interviews plus a take-home assessment on a real codebase. We aim to finish within a week.</p> <p>The assessment runs in two stages: you'll submit, get real feedback from an engineer on this team, and have time to act on it. Use the tools you use every day. You'll be asked to walk through your reasoning, so bring it.</p> <p data-speechify-sentence=""><strong>What We Offer </strong></p> <ul> <li>A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products</li> <li>A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive</li> <li>Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity</li> <li>The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry</li> <li>Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture</li> <li>The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more</li> <li>An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain</li> </ul> <p><strong>The Switzerland Based </strong>Salary range for this role is: 30,000-160,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience.</p><p><strong>Think you’re a good fit for this job? </strong></p> <p>Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply. <br>And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.</p> <p><strong>Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit? </strong></p> <p>Refer them! </p> <p><strong>Speechify is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. </strong></p> <p>Speechify does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.</p> Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

<h4><strong>Benefits and Perks</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday:</li> <ul> <li>25 days of paid vacation</li> <li>Additional paid time off for key life week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)</li> </ul> <li>Focus on your career growth:</li> <ul> <li>Development Dollars</li> <li>Leadership <p>At OpenTable, we pride ourselves on fostering a global and dynamic work environment. title: Product Engineer
description: The Context Banks still run their most critical, regulated work by hand; reading letters and emails, re-keying data between systems, chasing down missing info. It's the kind of work that's too important to get wrong and too tedious for anyone to want to do. Porters fixes this. Our AI agents run these regulated processes end to end, with the audit trails and security banks actually require, so the work moves at the speed customers expect instead of the speed a backlog allows. We're just over a year old and already live with real customers, growing the product quickly, and were named Fintech of the Year 2026. The goal is to build the operating system for autonomous banking. We're backed by Earlybird, one of Europe's oldest venture firms, and Seedcamp, who wrote first checks into Revolut, Wise, and UiPath. The Mission You'll own features in their entirety. Self-standing or with guidance of founders and fellow engineers, you turn a clear problem statement into a strong design and build, test, and ship new features that directly enable our customers. You integrate features across our layered stack, from the API to the data plane, and carry them all the way to production. This job is in person in Zurich, or remote in Barcelona or Berlin. Your responsibilities Ship features end-to-end: Deliver complete vertical slices across the stack, from the API layer to the data model, carried through to running in production. Grow what the platform does for banks: Build the services Porters performs for banks: Extend the capabilities of our agentic platform such as case handling, customer matching, AI tool integrations, data enrichment, or keeping humans in the loop. Deliver features that hold together as a system: Design endpoints, contracts, and interfaces that work together, ensuring features integrate cleanly towards one bigger outcome. Ensure your work is reliable: Own design, development, tests, and deployment, so what reaches production is proven to work. Wow our customers: You solve for the customer's actual problem, not just the request and measure success by customer outcomes. What would it take for the customer to say “Porters, made my day”. Your profile Experience: Around 4 years of professional software engineering, with a track record of shipping in fast-paced, ambiguous environments. Regulated industry and/or VC-backed startup experiences are a plus. Product thinking: You naturally understand why you’re building something, not just focusing on how to build. Quality focus & individual problem solving: Given a clear problem, you reliably produce a clean algorithm, a sensible data model, a well-structured service. You treat tests and observability as part of the feature, and right-size rigor to risk. You are comfortable in a regulated fintech environment where precision matters. Technical proficiency: Proficiency in Python is mandatory, along with REST API development, an ORM, and relational databases. AI-native: You've worked with, or are eager to work with, LLM/agentic tooling, and understand how to bound probabilistic output with deterministic code. Collaboration and eagerness to learn: You thrive on direction, review, and challenge, take feedback well, and want to grow into larger scopes. You are eager to learn every day. Going the extra mile: Be part of a high-growth phase, where we move fast and expect focused intensity. 9-to-5 is not the mode we work in, if you want to build something that matters with a team that ships, we are your people. What We Offer Ownership from day one: Real features running in production at major financial institutions, with the trust to carry them there yourself. Founder collaboration: Work directly with founders who have built and scaled fintech and analytics products before. We win and lose together as a team: We expect people to leave their comfort zone on a daily basis, however, we work together as a team and support each other at any time. Growth: A dedicated development budget, free to use for whatever gives you a level-up. Culture: Strong focus on a healthy, high-performance team culture, ranging from regular team events and dinners to an inclusive, fast-paced team that grows together. Our stack Core Backend: Python 3.14, FastAPI, Pydantic, and SQLAlchemy 2.0 in a strict four-layer architecture, exposed as separate internal and external APIs. Background processing: Containerized worker services and event-driven AWS Lambda orchestrators for email ingestion, document triaging, and action running. AI Integration: AI orchestration deeply integrated into application landscape via AWS Bedrock, e.g., to extract information and drive agentic activity. Data & Storage: Per-tenant Aurora MySQL in isolated subnets, S3 for document persistence, and an append-only ledger for auditability. Platform: A multi-tenant AWS environment on ECS Fargate with strict per-tenant network and data isolation (VPC, NACLs, WAF), CloudFront + Cognito (Google SSO/JWT) and API Gateway (IAM) at the edge, defined as code in CloudFormation across dev/staging/prod accounts. Frontend: React single-page app for the internal workbench. Dev Workflow: uv, Ruff, ty, pytest (unit, integration, property-based), Docker, GitHub Actions, and heavy use of Agentic IDEs to accelerate feature shipping.
